2.4.m: All [the deities] headed by Dharma, witnesses to the actions of righteousness and unrighteousness, / declared that you, the lord, were here in the place of the Kṛttikās.

2.4.s:
prababhūva rahaḥ krīḍā pārvatīśivayoḥ purā |
dṛṣṭasya ca suraiḥ śambhorvīryaṃ bhūmau papāta ha ||
2.4.d:
प्रबभूव रहः क्रीडा पार्वतीशिवयोः पुरा ।
दृष्टस्य च सुरैः शम्भोर्वीर्यं भूमौ पपात ह ॥
2.4.m: Formerly, the secret love-play of Pārvatī and Śiva took place; / seen by the gods, Śambhu's semen fell upon the earth.

2.4.s:
bhūmistadakṣipadvahnau vahniścādrau sa bhūdharaḥ |
gaṅgāyāṃ so'kṣipadvegāt taraṅgaiḥ śarakānane ||
2.4.d:
भूमिस्तदक्षिपद्वह्नौ वह्निश्चाद्रौ स भूधरः ।
गङ्गायां सोऽक्षिपद्वेगात् तरङ्गैः शरकानने ॥
2.4.m: The earth cast it into the fire, and the fire [cast it] onto the mountain; that mountain / cast it into the Gaṅgā, and she, by her waves, swiftly [cast it] into the reed forest.

2.4.s:
tatra bālo'bhavastvaṃ hi devakāryakṛtiḥ prabhuḥ |
tatra labdhaḥ kṛttikābhistvaṃ bhūmiṃ gaccha sāmpratam ||
2.4.d:
तत्र बालोऽभवस्त्वं हि देवकार्यकृतिः प्रभुः ।
तत्र लब्धः कृत्तिकाभिस्त्वं भूमिं गच्छ साम्प्रतम् ॥
2.4.m: There you indeed became a boy, the lord who accomplishes the mission of the gods; / found there by the Kṛttikās, go now to [our] land.

2.4.s:
tavābhiṣekaṃ śambhustu kariṣyati suraiḥ saha |
lapsyase sarvaśastrāṇi tārakākhyaṃ haniṣyasi ||
2.4.d:
तवाभिषेकं शम्भुस्तु करिष्यति सुरैः सह ।
लप्स्यसे सर्वशस्त्राणि तारकाख्यं हनिष्यसि ॥
2.4.m: Śambhu together with the gods will perform your consecration; / you will obtain all weapons and will slay the one named Tāraka.

2.4.s:
putrastvaṃ viśvasaṃharttustvāṃ prāptuṃ cā'kṣamā imāḥ |
nāgniṃ goptuṃ yathā śaktaḥ śuṣkavṛkṣaḥ svakoṭare ||
2.4.d:
पुत्रस्त्वं विश्वसंहर्त्तुस्त्वां प्राप्तुं चाऽक्षमा इमाः ।
नाग्निं गोप्तुं यथा शक्तः शुष्कवृक्षः स्वकोटरे ॥
2.4.m: You are the son of the destroyer of the universe, and these [women] are incapable of possessing you; / just as a dry tree is unable to hide fire within its hollow.

2.4.s:
dīptavāṃstvaṃ ca viśveṣu nāsāṃ geheṣu śobhase |
yathā patanmahākūpe dvijarājo na rājate ||
2.4.d:
दीप्तवांस्त्वं च विश्वेषु नासां गेहेषु शोभसे ।
यथा पतन्महाकूपे द्विजराजो न राजते ॥
2.4.m: You are radiant throughout the worlds; you do not look fitting in the houses of these [women], / just as the moon, king of the twice-born, does not shine when fallen into a deep well.

2.4.s:
karoṣi ca yathā''lokaṃ nā''cchanno'smāsu tejasā |
yathā sūryaḥ kalācchanno na bhavenmānavasya ca ||
2.4.d:
करोषि च यथा'ऽलोकं ना'ऽच्छन्नोऽस्मासु तेजसा ।
यथा सूर्यः कलाच्छन्नो न भवेन्मानवस्य च ॥
2.4.m: And just as you produce light, you are not veiled among us by your splendor; / just as the sun cannot be obscured by a part [of a cloud] to the mortal.

2.4.s:
viṣṇustvaṃ jagatāṃ vyāpī nānyo jāto'si śāmbhava |
yathā na keṣāṃ vyāpyaṃ ca tatsarvaṃ vyāpakaṃ nabhaḥ ||
2.4.d:
विष्णुस्त्वं जगतां व्यापी नान्यो जातोऽसि शाम्भव ।
यथा न केषां व्याप्यं च तत्सर्वं व्यापकं नभः ॥
2.4.m: You are Viṣṇu, all-pervading in the worlds, born of Śambhu, not another; / just as the sky, which cannot be pervaded by anything, pervades all that.

2.4.s:
yogīndro nā'nuliptaśca bhāgī cetparipoṣaṇe |
naiva lipto yathātmā ca karmayogeṣu jīvinām ||
2.4.d:
योगीन्द्रो नाऽनुलिप्तश्च भागी चेत्परिपोषणे ।
नैव लिप्तो यथात्मा च कर्मयोगेषु जीविनाम् ॥
2.4.m: You are the lord of yogins, unstained even if sharing in their nurturing, / just as the Self is never tainted in the actions of living beings.

2.4.s:
viśvārambhastvamīśaśca nāsu te sambhavet sthitiḥ |
guṇānāṃ tejasāṃ rāśiryathātmānaṃ ca yoginaḥ ||
2.4.d:
विश्वारम्भस्त्वमीशश्च नासु ते सम्भवेत् स्थितिः ।
गुणानां तेजसां राशिर्यथात्मानं च योगिनः ॥
2.4.m: You are the origin of the universe and the Lord; your dwelling cannot be in these [women], / just as the multitude of qualities and splendors [cannot be confined], or the Self for yogins.

2.4.s:
bhrātarye tvāṃ na jānanti te narā hatabuddhayaḥ |
nādriyante yathā bhekāstvekavāsāśca paṅkajān ||
2.4.d:
भ्रातर्ये त्वां न जानन्ति ते नरा हतबुद्धयः ।
नाद्रियन्ते यथा भेकास्त्वेकवासाश्च पङ्कजान् ॥
2.4.m: Brother, those men who do not recognize you are bereft of understanding, / just as frogs living in the same place do not esteem lotuses.

2.4.s:
kārttikeya uvāca
bhrātaḥsarvaṃ vijānāsi jñānaṃ traikālikaṃ ca yat |
jñānī tvaṃ kā praśaṃsā te yato mṛtyuñjayāśritaḥ ||
2.4.d:
कार्त्तिकेय उवाच
भ्रातःसर्वं विजानासि ज्ञानं त्रैकालिकं च यत् ।
ज्ञानी त्वं का प्रशंसा ते यतो मृत्युञ्जयाश्रितः ॥
2.4.m:
Kārtikeya said:
"Brother, you know everything, possessing knowledge that belongs to the three times; / you are wise, so what praise of yours [is needed], since you have taken refuge in the Conqueror of Death?

2.4.s:
karmaṇāṃ janma yeṣāṃ vā yāsu yāsu ca yoniṣu |
tāsu te nirvṛtiṃ bhrātaḥ prāpnuvantīha sāmpratam ||
2.4.d:
कर्मणां जन्म येषां वा यासु यासु च योनिषु ।
तासु ते निर्वृतिं भ्रातः प्राप्नुवन्तीह साम्प्रतम् ॥
2.4.m: Whatever births of beings [occur] through their deeds in whatever wombs, / in those they find their satisfaction, brother, here and now.

2.4.s:
kṛttikājñānavatyaśca yoginyaḥ prakṛteḥ kalāḥ |
stanyenāsāṃ varddhito'hamupakāreṇa santatam ||
2.4.d:
कृत्तिकाज्ञानवत्यश्च योगिन्यः प्रकृतेः कलाः ।
स्तन्येनासां वर्द्धितोऽहमुपकारेण सन्ततम् ॥
2.4.m: The Kṛttikās are endowed with wisdom, yoginīs, portions of Prakṛti; / I have been constantly nurtured by their breast milk and kindness.

2.4.s:
āsāmahaṃ poṣyaputro madaṃśā yoṣitastvimāḥ |
tasyāśca prakṛteraṃśāstatastatsvāmivīryajaḥ ||
2.4.d:
आसामहं पोष्यपुत्रो मदंशा योषितस्त्विमाः ।
तस्याश्च प्रकृतेरंशास्ततस्तत्स्वामिवीर्यजः ॥
2.4.m: I am their foster-son, and these women are portions of mine, / and portions of that Prakṛti; therefore, I was born of her husband's semen.

2.4.s:
na madbhavo he śailendrakanyayā nandikeśvara |
sā ca me dharmato mātā yathemāḥ sarvasammatāḥ ||
2.4.d:
न मद्भवो हे शैलेन्द्रकन्यया नन्दिकेश्वर ।
सा च मे धर्मतो माता यथेमाः सर्वसम्मताः ॥
2.4.m: My birth was not from the daughter of the king of mountains, O Nandikeśvara; / yet she is my mother by righteousness, just as these [are], as agreed by all."

2.4.s:
śambhunā preṣitastvaṃ ca śambhoḥ putrasamo mahān |
āgacchāmi tvayā sārddhaṃ drakṣyāmi devatākulam ||
2.4.d:
शम्भुना प्रेषितस्त्वं च शम्भोः पुत्रसमो महान् ।
आगच्छामि त्वया सार्द्धं द्रक्ष्यामि देवताकुलम् ॥
2.4.m: "And you were sent by Śambhu; great one, you are like Śambhu’s son. / I shall go with you and see the host of the gods."

2.4.s:
ityevamuktvā taṃ śīghraṃ sambodhya kṛttikāgaṇam |
kārttikeyaḥ pratasthe hi sārddhaṃ śaṅkarapārṣadaiḥ ||
śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ ||
śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ ||
śrīśivamahāpurāṇam ||
dvitīyāyāṃ rudrasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthaḥ kumārakhaṇḍe
2.4.d:
इत्येवमुक्त्वा तं शीघ्रं सम्बोध्य कृत्तिकागणम् ।
कार्त्तिकेयः प्रतस्थे हि सार्द्धं शङ्करपार्षदैः ॥
श्रीगणेशाय नमः ॥
श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः ॥
श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥
द्वितीयायां रुद्रसंहितायां चतुर्थः कुमारखण्डे
2.4.m:
Having spoken thus to him, and having quickly comforted the group of Kṛttikās, / Kārttikeya set forth indeed together with Śaṅkara’s attendants.

Thus ends the fourth chapter, titled "The Description of the Search for Kārttikeya and the Dialogue with Nandin," in the Kumārakhaṇḍa, the fourth section of the second Rudrasaṃhitā, in the glorious Śiva Mahāpurāṇa.

2.4.s:
brahmovāca etasminnantare tatra dadarśa rathamuttamam |
adbhutaṃ śobhitaṃ śaśvadviśvakarmavinirmitam ||
2.4.d:
ब्रह्मोवाच एतस्मिन्नन्तरे तत्र ददर्श रथमुत्तमम् ।
अद्भुतं शोभितं शश्वद्विश्वकर्मविनिर्मितम् ॥
2.4.m: Brahmā said: / In the meantime, he saw there an excellent chariot, / wondrous, constantly adorned, fashioned by Viśvakarman,

2.4.s:
śatacakraṃ suvistīrṇaṃ manoyāyi manoharam |
prasthāpitaṃ ca pārvatyā veṣṭitaṃ pārṣadairvaraiḥ ||
2.4.d:
शतचक्रं सुविस्तीर्णं मनोयायि मनोहरम् ।
प्रस्थापितं च पार्वत्या वेष्टितं पार्षदैर्वरैः ॥
2.4.m: having a hundred wheels, very spacious, swift as thought, captivating the heart, / dispatched by Pārvatī and surrounded by noble attendants.

2.4.s:
samārohattato'nanto hṛdayena vidūyatā |
kārttikaḥ paramajñānī parameśānavīryajaḥ ||
2.4.d:
समारोहत्ततोऽनन्तो हृदयेन विदूयता ।
कार्त्तिकः परमज्ञानी परमेशानवीर्यजः ॥
2.4.m: Then the infinite Kārttika, born of Parameśāna’s semen, / endowed with supreme knowledge, mounted it with an aching heart.

2.4.s:
tadaiva kṛttikāḥ prāpya muktakeśyaḥ śucā''turāḥ |
unmattā iva tatraiva vaktumārebhire vacaḥ ||
2.4.d:
तदैव कृत्तिकाः प्राप्य मुक्तकेश्यः शुचा'ऽतुराः ।
उन्मत्ता इव तत्रैव वक्तुमारेभिरे वचः ॥
2.4.m: Right then the Kṛttikās arrived with disheveled hair, afflicted with sorrow, / and right there, like mad women, began to speak:

2.4.s:
kṛttikā ūcuḥ |
vihāyā'smān kṛpāsindho gacchasi tvaṃ hi nirdayaḥ |
nāyaṃ dharmo mātṛvargān pālito yat sutastyajet ||
2.4.d:
कृत्तिका ऊचुः ।
विहायाऽस्मान् कृपासिन्धो गच्छसि त्वं हि निर्दयः ।
नायं धर्मो मातृवर्गान् पालितो यत् सुतस्त्यजेत् ॥
2.4.m: The Kṛttikās said: / "Leaving us behind, O ocean of compassion, you are departing, ruthless indeed! / It is not righteous for a fostered son to abandon his mothers.

2.4.s:
snehena varddhito'smābhiḥ putro'smākaṃ ca dharmataḥ |
kiṃ kurmaḥ kva ca yāsyāmo vayaṃ kiṃ karavāma ha ||
2.4.d:
स्नेहेन वर्द्धितोऽस्माभिः पुत्रोऽस्माकं च धर्मतः ।
किं कुर्मः क्व च यास्यामो वयं किं करवाम ह ॥
2.4.m: Raised by us with affection, you are our son by righteousness. / What shall we do? Where shall we go? What can we do?"

2.4.s:
ityuktvā kṛttikāḥ sarvāḥ kṛtvā vakṣasi kārttikam |
drutaṃ mūrcchāmavāpustāḥsutavicchedakāraṇāt ||
2.4.d:
इत्युक्त्वा कृत्तिकाः सर्वाः कृत्वा वक्षसि कार्त्तिकम् ।
द्रुतं मूर्च्छामवापुस्ताःसुतविच्छेदकारणात् ॥
2.4.m: Having spoken thus, all the Kṛttikās clasped Kārttika to their bosoms, / and quickly fell into a swoon due to separation from their son.

2.4.s:
tāḥ kumāro bodhayitvā adhyātmavacanena vai |
tābhiśca pārṣadaiḥ sārddhamāruroha rathaṃ mune ||
2.4.d:
ताः कुमारो बोधयित्वा अध्यात्मवचनेन वै ।
ताभिश्च पार्षदैः सार्द्धमारुरोह रथं मुने ॥
2.4.m: Having consoled them with words on the supreme Self, / the boy, O sage, mounted the chariot together with them and the attendants.

2.4.s:
dṛṣṭvā śrutvā maṅgalāni bahūni sukhadāni vai |
kumāraḥ pārṣadaiḥ sārddhaṃ jagāma pitṛmandiram ||
2.4.d:
दृष्ट्वा श्रुत्वा मङ्गलानि बहूनि सुखदानि वै ।
कुमारः पार्षदैः सार्द्धं जगाम पितृमन्दिरम् ॥
2.4.m: Seeing and hearing many auspicious things that bestow happiness, / the boy went to his father’s abode along with the attendants.

2.4.s:
dakṣeṇa nandiyuktaśca manoyāyirathena ca |
kumāraḥ prāpa kailāsaṃ nyagrodhā'kṣayamūlake ||
2.4.d:
दक्षेण नन्दियुक्तश्च मनोयायिरथेन च ।
कुमारः प्राप कैलासं न्यग्रोधाऽक्षयमूलके ॥
2.4.m: Accompanied by Nandin on his right, and riding the chariot swift as thought, / the boy reached Kailāsa at the root of the imperishable banyan tree.

2.4.s:
tatra tasthau kṛttikābhiḥ pārṣadapravaraiḥ saha |
kumāraḥ śāṅkariḥ prīto nānālīlāviśāradaḥ ||
2.4.d:
तत्र तस्थौ कृत्तिकाभिः पार्षदप्रवरैः सह ।
कुमारः शाङ्करिः प्रीतो नानालीलाविशारदः ॥
2.4.m: There the boy, Śaṅkara’s son, skilled in various pastimes, / delighted, stayed together with the Kṛttikās and the foremost attendants.

2.4.s:
tadā sarve suragaṇā ṛṣayaḥ siddhacāraṇāḥ |
viṣṇunā brahmaṇā sārddhaṃ samācakhyustadāgamam ||
tadā dṛṣṭvā ca gāṅgeyaṃ yayau pramuditaśśivaḥ |
anyaiḥ sameto hariṇā brahmaṇā ca surarṣibhiḥ | 13 ||
2.4.d:
तदा सर्वे सुरगणा ऋषयः सिद्धचारणाः ।
विष्णुना ब्रह्मणा सार्द्धं समाचख्युस्तदागमम् ॥
तदा दृष्ट्वा च गाङ्गेयं ययौ प्रमुदितश्शिवः ।
अन्यैः समेतो हरिणा ब्रह्मणा च सुरर्षिभिः । 13 ॥
2.4.m:
Then all the hosts of gods, the sages, the Siddhas and Cāraṇas, / along with Viṣṇu and Brahmā, announced his arrival.

Then, having seen the son of Gaṅgā, the delighted Śiva went forth, / accompanied by others, by Hari, by Brahmā, and by celestial sages.

2.4.s:
śaṅkhāśca bahavo nedurbherī tūryāṇyanekaśaḥ |
utsavaḥ sumahānāsīddevānāṃ tuṣṭacetasām ||
2.4.d:
शङ्खाश्च बहवो नेदुर्भेरी तूर्याण्यनेकशः ।
उत्सवः सुमहानासीद्देवानां तुष्टचेतसाम् ॥
2.4.m: Many conches resounded, and kettledrums and musical instruments in large numbers; / there was a very great festival of the delighted gods.

2.4.s:
tadānīmeva taṃ sarve vīrabhadrādayo gaṇāḥ |
kurvantaḥ svanvayuḥ keliṃ nānātāladharasvarāḥ ||
2.4.d:
तदानीमेव तं सर्वे वीरभद्रादयो गणाः ।
कुर्वन्तः स्वन्वयुः केलिं नानातालधरस्वराः ॥
2.4.m: Right then all the attendants, headed by Vīrabhadra, / playing sports, made pleasant sounds with varied rhythms and notes.

2.4.s:
stāvakāḥ stūyamānāśca cakruste guṇakīrttanam |
jayaśabdaṃ namaśśabdaṃ kurvāṇāḥ prītamānasāḥ ||
draṣṭuṃ yayustaṃ śarajaṃ śivātmajamanuttamam | 17 ||
2.4.d:
स्तावकाः स्तूयमानाश्च चक्रुस्ते गुणकीर्त्तनम् ।
जयशब्दं नमश्शब्दं कुर्वाणाः प्रीतमानसाः ॥
द्रष्टुं ययुस्तं शरजं शिवात्मजमनुत्तमम् । 17 ॥
2.4.m:
Praisers praised him and proclaimed his virtues, / uttering shouts of victory and salutations with delighted minds.

They went to see the reed-born, peerless son of Śiva.

2.4.s:
pārvatī maṅgalaṃ cakre rājamārgaṃ manoharam |
padmarāgādimaṇibhiḥ saṃskṛtaṃ paritaḥ puram ||
2.4.d:
पार्वती मङ्गलं चक्रे राजमार्गं मनोहरम् ।
पद्मरागादिमणिभिः संस्कृतं परितः पुरम् ॥
2.4.m: Pārvatī made the royal road auspicious and charming; / all around, the city was decorated with rubies and other gems.

2.4.s:
patiputravatībhiśca sādhvībhiḥ strībhiranvitāḥ |
lakṣmyāditriṃśaddevīśca puraḥ kṛtvā samāyayau ||
2.4.d:
पतिपुत्रवतीभिश्च साध्वीभिः स्त्रीभिरन्विताः ।
लक्ष्म्यादित्रिंशद्देवीश्च पुरः कृत्वा समाययौ ॥
2.4.m: Accompanied by virtuous women who had husbands and sons, / placing Lakṣmī and the other thirty goddesses in front, she came forth.

2.4.s:
rambhādyapsaraso divyāḥ sasmitā veṣasaṃyutāḥ |
saṅgītanartanaparā babhūvuśca śivājñayā ||
2.4.d:
रम्भाद्यप्सरसो दिव्याः सस्मिता वेषसंयुताः ।
सङ्गीतनर्तनपरा बभूवुश्च शिवाज्ञया ॥
2.4.m: The celestial apsarases, Rambhā and others, smiling and well adorned, / devoted themselves to singing and dancing by Śiva's command.

2.4.s:
ye taṃ samīkṣayāmāsurgāṅgeyaṃ śaṅkaropamam |
dadṛśuste mahattejo vyāptamāsījjagattraye ||
2.4.d:
ये तं समीक्षयामासुर्गाङ्गेयं शङ्करोपमम् ।
ददृशुस्ते महत्तेजो व्याप्तमासीज्जगत्त्रये ॥
2.4.m: Those who looked upon him, the son of Gaṅgā, who was like Śaṅkara, / saw a great splendor that pervaded the three worlds.

2.4.s:
tattejasā vṛtaṃ bālaṃ taptacāmīkaraprabham |
vavandire drutaṃ sarve kumāraṃ sūryavarcasam ||
2.4.d:
तत्तेजसा वृतं बालं तप्तचामीकरप्रभम् ।
ववन्दिरे द्रुतं सर्वे कुमारं सूर्यवर्चसम् ॥
2.4.m: Surrounded by that splendor, the child had the radiance of molten gold; / quickly, all bowed to the boy who possessed the brilliance of the sun.

2.4.s:
jahṛṣurvinataskandhā namaśśabdaratāstadā |
parivāryopatasthuste vāmadakṣiṇamāgatāḥ ||
2.4.d:
जहृषुर्विनतस्कन्धा नमश्शब्दरतास्तदा ।
परिवार्योपतस्थुस्ते वामदक्षिणमागताः ॥
2.4.m: With bent shoulders, devoted to cries of 'Obeisance!', they rejoiced then; / having arrived to his left and right, they stood surrounding him.

2.4.s:
ahaṃ viṣṇuśca śakraśca tathā devādayo'khilāḥ |
daṇḍavatpatitā bhūmau parivārya kumārakam ||
2.4.d:
अहं विष्णुश्च शक्रश्च तथा देवादयोऽखिलाः ।
दण्डवत्पतिता भूमौ परिवार्य कुमारकम् ॥
2.4.m: I, Viṣṇu, Śakra, and all the gods and others, / fell like a staff upon the ground, surrounding the boy.

2.4.s:
etasminnantare śambhurgirijā ca mudānvitā |
mahotsavaṃ samāgamya dadarśa tanayaṃ mudā ||
2.4.d:
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे शम्भुर्गिरिजा च मुदान्विता ।
महोत्सवं समागम्य ददर्श तनयं मुदा ॥
2.4.m: In the meantime, Śambhu and the mountain's daughter, full of joy, / came to the great festival and beheld their son with delight.

2.4.s:
putraṃ nirīkṣya ca tadā jagadekabandhuḥ prītyānvitaḥ paramayā parayā bhavānyā |
snehānvito bhujagabhogayuto hi sākṣāt sarveśvaraḥ parivṛtaḥ pramathaiḥ pareśaḥ ||
2.4.d:
पुत्रं निरीक्ष्य च तदा जगदेकबन्धुः प्रीत्यान्वितः परमया परया भवान्या ।
स्नेहान्वितो भुजगभोगयुतो हि साक्षात् सर्वेश्वरः परिवृतः प्रमथैः परेशः ॥
2.4.m: And gazing upon his son, the sole friend of the universe, endowed with supreme love, / filled with affection alongside the supreme Bhavānī, embraced by coils of serpents, / the Lord of All, the Supreme Lord in visible form, was surrounded by the Pramathas.

2.4.s:
atha śaktidharaḥ skando dṛṣṭvā tau pārvatīśivau |
avaruhya rathāttūrṇaṃ śirasā praṇanāma ha ||
2.4.d:
अथ शक्तिधरः स्कन्दो दृष्ट्वा तौ पार्वतीशिवौ ।
अवरुह्य रथात्तूर्णं शिरसा प्रणनाम ह ॥
2.4.m: Then Skanda, wielder of the lance, upon seeing Pārvatī and Śiva, / quickly descended from the chariot and bowed with his head.

2.4.s:
upaguhya śivaḥ prītyā kumāraṃ mūrdhni śaṅkaraḥ |
jaghrau premṇā pareśānaḥ prasannaḥ snehakartṛkaḥ ||
2.4.d:
उपगुह्य शिवः प्रीत्या कुमारं मूर्ध्नि शङ्करः ।
जघ्रौ प्रेम्णा परेशानः प्रसन्नः स्नेहकर्तृकः ॥
2.4.m: Embracing the boy with love, Śiva, Śaṅkara, / the serene Parameśāna, filled with affection, lovingly smelled his head.

2.4.s:
upaguhya guhaṃ tatra pārvatī jātasambhramā |
prasnutaṃ pāyayāmāsa stanaṃ snehapariplutā ||
2.4.d:
उपगुह्य गुहं तत्र पार्वती जातसम्भ्रमा ।
प्रस्नुतं पाययामास स्तनं स्नेहपरिप्लुता ॥
2.4.m: Embracing Guha there, Pārvatī was agitated with emotion; / overflowed with affection, she suckled him with her flowing breast.

2.4.s:
tadā nīrājito devaiḥsakalatrairmudānvitaiḥ |
jayaśabdena mahatā vyāptamāsīnnabhastalam ||
2.4.d:
तदा नीराजितो देवैःसकलत्रैर्मुदान्वितैः ।
जयशब्देन महता व्याप्तमासीन्नभस्तलम् ॥
2.4.m: Then, as he was honored with waving lights by the joyful gods along with their wives, / the vault of the sky was filled with a great cry of victory.

2.4.s:
ṛṣayo brahmaghoṣeṇa gītenaiva ca gāyakāḥ |
vādyaiśca bahavastatropatasthuśca kumārakam ||
2.4.d:
ऋषयो ब्रह्मघोषेण गीतेनैव च गायकाः ।
वाद्यैश्च बहवस्तत्रोपतस्थुश्च कुमारकम् ॥
2.4.m: The sages with chanting of the Veda, singers with song, / and many with musical instruments approached the boy there.

2.4.s:
svamaṅkamāropya tadā maheśaḥ kumārakaṃ taṃ prabhayā samujjvalam |
babhau bhavānīpatireva sākṣā-cchriyā'nvitaḥ putravatāṃ variṣṭhaḥ ||
2.4.d:
स्वमङ्कमारोप्य तदा महेशः कुमारकं तं प्रभया समुज्ज्वलम् ।
बभौ भवानीपतिरेव साक्षा-च्छ्रियाऽन्वितः पुत्रवतां वरिष्ठः ॥
2.4.m: Then, placing the boy, who was blazing with splendor, on his lap, / Maheśa, the husband of Bhavānī, visibly endowed with fortune, shone as the foremost among those having sons.

2.4.s:
kumāraḥ svagaṇaiḥ sārddhamājagāma śivālayam |
śivājñayā mahotsāhaissaha devairmahāsukhī ||
2.4.d:
कुमारः स्वगणैः सार्द्धमाजगाम शिवालयम् ।
शिवाज्ञया महोत्साहैस्सह देवैर्महासुखी ॥
2.4.m: With great enthusiasm, by Śiva's command, the boy went with his attendants / to Śiva’s abode along with the gods, exceedingly happy.

2.4.s:
dampatī tau tadā tatraikapadyena virejatuḥ |
vivandyamānāvṛṣibhirāvṛtau surasattamaiḥ ||
2.4.d:
दम्पती तौ तदा तत्रैकपद्येन विरेजतुः ।
विवन्द्यमानावृषिभिरावृतौ सुरसत्तमैः ॥
2.4.m: Then both husband and wife shone there in harmony, / saluted by the sages and surrounded by the foremost gods.

2.4.s:
kumāraḥ krīḍayāmāsa śivotsaṅge mudānvitaḥ |
vāsukiṃ śivakaṇṭhasthaṃ pāṇibhyāṃ samapīḍayat ||
2.4.d:
कुमारः क्रीडयामास शिवोत्सङ्गे मुदान्वितः ।
वासुकिं शिवकण्ठस्थं पाणिभ्यां समपीडयत् ॥
2.4.m: The boy played with delight on Śiva’s lap; / with both hands he squeezed Vāsuki, who was on Śiva’s neck.

2.4.s:
prahasya bhagavān śambhuḥ śaśaṃsa girijāṃ tadā |
nirīkṣya kṛpayā dṛṣṭyā kṛpālurlīlayākṛtim ||
2.4.d:
प्रहस्य भगवान् शम्भुः शशंस गिरिजां तदा ।
निरीक्ष्य कृपया दृष्ट्या कृपालुर्लीलयाकृतिम् ॥
2.4.m: Laughing, the lord Śambhu praised the mountain's daughter then; / gazing upon his playful form with a glance of grace, the compassionate one [rejoiced].

2.4.s:
madasmitena ca tadā bhagavānmaheśaḥ prāpto mudaṃ ca paramāṃ girijāsametaḥ |
premṇā sa gadgadagiro jagadekabandhu-rnovāca kiñcana vibhurbhuvanaikabharttā ||
2.4.d:
मदस्मितेन च तदा भगवान्महेशः प्राप्तो मुदं च परमां गिरिजासमेतः ।
प्रेम्णा स गद्गदगिरो जगदेकबन्धु-र्नोवाच किञ्चन विभुर्भुवनैकभर्त्ता ॥
2.4.m: Then, with an intoxicating smile, the lord Maheśa, together with the mountain's daughter, attained supreme joy; / with words choked with love, the sole friend of the universe, the all-pervading sole master of the worlds, said nothing at all.

2.4.s:
atha śambhurjagannātho hṛṣṭo laukikavṛttavān |
ratnasiṃhāsane ramye vāsayāmāsa kārttikam ||
2.4.d:
अथ शम्भुर्जगन्नाथो हृष्टो लौकिकवृत्तवान् ।
रत्नसिंहासने रम्ये वासयामास कार्त्तिकम् ॥
2.4.m: Then Śambhu, the lord of the universe, pleased and acting in the worldly manner, / seated Kārttika upon a delightful jeweled throne.

2.4.s:
vedamantrābhipūtaiśca sarvatīrthodapūrṇakaiḥ |
sadratnakumbhaśatakaiḥ snāpayāmāsa taṃ mudā ||
2.4.d:
वेदमन्त्राभिपूतैश्च सर्वतीर्थोदपूर्णकैः ।
सद्रत्नकुम्भशतकैः स्नापयामास तं मुदा ॥
2.4.m: With hundreds of jars of excellent gems filled with water from all sacred waters / and consecrated with Vedic mantras, he bathed him with joy.

2.4.s:
sadratnasāraracitakirīṭamukuṭāṅgadam |
vaijayantīṃ svamālāṃ ca tasmai cakraṃ dadau hariḥ ||
2.4.d:
सद्रत्नसाररचितकिरीटमुकुटाङ्गदम् ।
वैजयन्तीं स्वमालां च तस्मै चक्रं ददौ हरिः ॥
2.4.m: A crown, tiara, and armlets fashioned from the essence of excellent gems, / along with his own Vaijayantī garland and the discus, Hari gave to him.

2.4.s:
śūlaṃ pinākaṃ paraśuṃ śaktiṃ pāśupataṃ śaram |
saṃhārāstraṃ ca paramāṃ vidyāṃ tasmai dadau śivaḥ ||
2.4.d:
शूलं पिनाकं परशुं शक्तिं पाशुपतं शरम् ।
संहारास्त्रं च परमां विद्यां तस्मै ददौ शिवः ॥
2.4.m: Śiva gave him the trident, the Pināka bow, the axe, the lance, the Pāśupata arrow, / the weapon of destruction, and supreme knowledge.

2.4.s:
adāmahaṃ yajñasūtraṃ vedāṃśca vedamātaram |
kamaṇḍaluṃ ca brahmāstraṃ vidyāṃ caivā'rimardinīm ||
2.4.d:
अदामहं यज्ञसूत्रं वेदांश्च वेदमातरम् ।
कमण्डलुं च ब्रह्मास्त्रं विद्यां चैवाऽरिमर्दिनीम् ॥
2.4.m:
I gave the sacred thread, the Vedas, the Mother of the Vedas,
the water pot, the weapon of Brahmā, and the lore that crushes enemies.

2.4.s:
gajendraṃ caiva vajraṃ ca dadau tasmai sureśvaraḥ |
śvetacchatraṃ ratnamālāṃ dadau pāśaṃ jaleśvaraḥ ||
2.4.d:
गजेन्द्रं चैव वज्रं च ददौ तस्मै सुरेश्वरः ।
श्वेतच्छत्रं रत्नमालां ददौ पाशं जलेश्वरः ॥
2.4.m:
The lord of gods gave him the king of elephants and the thunderbolt;
the lord of waters gave a white umbrella, a string of jewels, and a noose.

2.4.s:
manoyāyirathaṃ sūryaḥ sannāhaṃ ca mahācayam |
yamadaṇḍaṃ yamaścaiva sudhākumbhaṃ sudhānidhiḥ ||
2.4.d:
मनोयायिरथं सूर्यः सन्नाहं च महाचयम् ।
यमदण्डं यमश्चैव सुधाकुम्भं सुधानिधिः ॥
2.4.m:
Sūrya gave a chariot that travels at the speed of thought and great armor;
Yama gave the staff of Yama, and the ocean of nectar gave a pot of nectar.

2.4.s:
hutāśano dadau prītyā mahāśaktiṃ svasūnave |
dadau svaśastraṃ nirṛtirvāyavyāstraṃ samīraṇaḥ ||
2.4.d:
हुताशनो ददौ प्रीत्या महाशक्तिं स्वसूनवे ।
ददौ स्वशस्त्रं निरृतिर्वायव्यास्त्रं समीरणः ॥
2.4.m:
The Fire-god with affection gave a great spear to his own son;
Nirṛti gave his own weapon, and the Wind gave the wind weapon.

2.4.s:
gadāṃ dadau kuberaśca śūlamīśo dadau mudā |
nānāśastrāṇyupāyāṃśca sarve devā dadurmudā ||
2.4.d:
गदां ददौ कुबेरश्च शूलमीशो ददौ मुदा ।
नानाशस्त्राण्युपायांश्च सर्वे देवा ददुर्मुदा ॥
2.4.m:
Kubera gave a mace, and Īśa gave a trident with joy;
all the gods with delight gave various weapons and means.

2.4.s:
kāmāstraṃ kāmadevo'tha dadau tasmai mudānvitaḥ |
gadāṃ dadau svavidyāśca tasmai ca parayā mudā ||
2.4.d:
कामास्त्रं कामदेवोऽथ ददौ तस्मै मुदान्वितः ।
गदां ददौ स्वविद्याश्च तस्मै च परया मुदा ॥
2.4.m:
Then Kāmadeva, filled with joy, gave him the love weapon;
he gave a mace and his own lores to him with supreme delight.

2.4.s:
kṣīrodo'mūlyaratnāni viśiṣṭaṃ ratnanūpuram |
himālayo hi divyāni bhūṣaṇānyaṃśukāni ca ||
2.4.d:
क्षीरोदोऽमूल्यरत्नानि विशिष्टं रत्ननूपुरम् ।
हिमालयो हि दिव्यानि भूषणान्यंशुकानि च ॥
2.4.m:
The milk ocean gave priceless jewels and an exquisite jeweled anklet;
the Himālaya indeed gave celestial ornaments and garments.

2.4.s:
citrabarhaṇanāmānaṃ svaputraṃ garuḍo dadau |
aruṇastāmracūḍākhyaṃ balinaṃ caraṇāyudham ||
2.4.d:
चित्रबर्हणनामानं स्वपुत्रं गरुडो ददौ ।
अरुणस्ताम्रचूडाख्यं बलिनं चरणायुधम् ॥
2.4.m:
Garuḍa gave his son named Citrabarhaṇa;
Aruṇa gave the mighty cock named Tāmracūḍa, whose feet are weapons.

2.4.s:
pārvatī sasmitā hṛṣṭā paramaiśvaryamuttamam |
dadau tasmai mahāprītyā cirañjīvitvameva ca ||
2.4.d:
पार्वती सस्मिता हृष्टा परमैश्वर्यमुत्तमम् ।
ददौ तस्मै महाप्रीत्या चिरञ्जीवित्वमेव च ॥
2.4.m:
Pārvatī, smiling and rejoicing, gave him supreme, excellent sovereignty
with great love, and indeed long life.

2.4.s:
lakṣmīśca sampadaṃ divyāṃ mahāhāraṃ manoharam |
sāvitrī siddhavidyāṃ ca samastāṃ pradadau mudā ||
2.4.d:
लक्ष्मीश्च सम्पदं दिव्यां महाहारं मनोहरम् ।
सावित्री सिद्धविद्यां च समस्तां प्रददौ मुदा ॥
2.4.m:
Lakṣmī gave divine fortune and an enchanting great garland;
Sāvitrī with joy bestowed the entire lore of the perfected.

2.4.s:
anyāścāpi mune devyo yā yāstatra samāgatāḥ |
svātmavatsu dadustasmai tathaiva śiśupālikāḥ ||
2.4.d:
अन्याश्चापि मुने देव्यो या यास्तत्र समागताः ।
स्वात्मवत्सु ददुस्तस्मै तथैव शिशुपालिकाः ॥
2.4.m:
And whatever other goddesses had arrived there, O sage,
gave to him as to their own children, as did the protectresses of children.

2.4.s:
mahāmahotsavastatra babhūva munisattama |
sarve prasannatāṃ yātā viśeṣācca śivāśivau ||
2.4.d:
महामहोत्सवस्तत्र बभूव मुनिसत्तम ।
सर्वे प्रसन्नतां याता विशेषाच्च शिवाशिवौ ॥
2.4.m:
A great, great festival took place there, O best of sages;
everyone attained delight, especially Śiva and Śivā.

2.4.s:
etasminnantare kāle provāca prahasan mudā |
mune brahmādikān devān rudro bhargaḥ pratāpavān ||
2.4.d:
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे काले प्रोवाच प्रहसन् मुदा ।
मुने ब्रह्मादिकान् देवान् रुद्रो भर्गः प्रतापवान् ॥
2.4.m:
Meanwhile, O sage, the glorious Rudra Bharga,
laughing with joy, spoke to the gods headed by Brahmā:

2.4.s:
śiva uvāca
he hare he vidhe devāḥ sarve śṛṇuta madvacaḥ |
sarvathāhaṃ prasanno'smi varānvṛṇuta aicchikān ||
2.4.d:
शिव उवाच
हे हरे हे विधे देवाः सर्वे शृणुत मद्वचः ।
सर्वथाहं प्रसन्नोऽस्मि वरान्वृणुत ऐच्छिकान् ॥
2.4.m:
Śiva said:
“O Hari, O Brahmā, O all you gods, hear my word:
I am pleased in every way; choose the boons you desire.”

2.4.s:
brahmovāca tacchrutvā vacanaṃ śambhormune viṣṇvādayaḥ surāḥ |
sarve procuḥ prasannāsyā devaṃ paśupatiṃ prabhum ||
2.4.d:
ब्रह्मोवाच तच्छ्रुत्वा वचनं शम्भोर्मुने विष्ण्वादयः सुराः ।
सर्वे प्रोचुः प्रसन्नास्या देवं पशुपतिं प्रभुम् ॥
2.4.m:
Brahmā said:
Hearing that word of Śambhu, O sage, the gods headed by Viṣṇu,
all with delighted faces, said to the Lord, the master of bound souls:

2.4.s:
kumāreṇa hato hyeṣa tārako bhavitā prabho |
tadarthameva sañjātamidaṃ caritamuttamam ||
2.4.d:
कुमारेण हतो ह्येष तारको भविता प्रभो ।
तदर्थमेव सञ्जातमिदं चरितमुत्तमम् ॥
2.4.m:
“This Tāraka is surely to be slain by Kumāra, O Lord;
for that purpose alone has this excellent deed taken place.

2.4.s:
tasmādadyaiva yāsyāmastārakaṃ hantumudyatāḥ |
ājñāṃ dehi kumārāya sa taṃ hanyāt sukhāya naḥ ||
2.4.d:
तस्मादद्यैव यास्यामस्तारकं हन्तुमुद्यताः ।
आज्ञां देहि कुमाराय स तं हन्यात् सुखाय नः ॥
2.4.m:
Therefore, this very day we will go forth, resolved to slay Tāraka;
give the command to Kumāra, so that he may slay him for our happiness.”

2.4.s:
tatheti matvā sa vibhurdattavāṃstanayaṃ tadā |
devebhyastārakaṃ hantuṃ kṛpayā paribhāvitaḥ ||
2.4.d:
तथेति मत्वा स विभुर्दत्तवांस्तनयं तदा ।
देवेभ्यस्तारकं हन्तुं कृपया परिभावितः ॥
2.4.m:
Thinking ‘so be it,’ that omnipresent Lord then gave his son
to the gods to slay Tāraka, overcome with compassion.

2.4.s:
śivājñayā surāḥ sarve brahmaviṣṇumukhāstadā |
puraskṛtya guhaṃ sadyo nirjagmurmilitā gireḥ ||
2.4.d:
शिवाज्ञया सुराः सर्वे ब्रह्मविष्णुमुखास्तदा ।
पुरस्कृत्य गुहं सद्यो निर्जग्मुर्मिलिता गिरेः ॥
2.4.m:
By Śiva's command, all the gods headed by Brahmā and Viṣṇu then
put Guha at their head and immediately departed together from the mountain.

2.4.s:
bahirnissṛtya kailāsāttvaṣṭā śāsanato hareḥ |
virece nagaraṃ ramyamadbhutaṃ nikaṭe gireḥ ||
2.4.d:
बहिर्निस्सृत्य कैलासात्त्वष्टा शासनतो हरेः ।
विरेचे नगरं रम्यमद्भुतं निकटे गिरेः ॥
2.4.m:
Having stepped outside Kailāsa, Tvaṣṭṛ, by the command of Hari,
fashioned a charming, wondrous city near the mountain.

2.4.s:
tatra ramyaṃ gṛhaṃ divyamadbhutaṃ paramojjvalam |
guhārthaṃ nirmame tvaṣṭā tatra siṃhāsanaṃ varam ||
2.4.d:
तत्र रम्यं गृहं दिव्यमद्भुतं परमोज्ज्वलम् ।
गुहार्थं निर्ममे त्वष्टा तत्र सिंहासनं वरम् ॥
2.4.m:
There Tvaṣṭṛ constructed a charming, divine, wondrous, and exceedingly radiant
house for Guha, and an excellent throne there.

2.4.s:
tadā hariḥ sudhīrbhaktyā kārayāmāsa maṅgalam |
kārttikasyābhiṣekaṃ hi sarvatīrthajalaiḥ suraiḥ ||
2.4.d:
तदा हरिः सुधीर्भक्त्या कारयामास मङ्गलम् ।
कार्त्तिकस्याभिषेकं हि सर्वतीर्थजलैः सुरैः ॥
2.4.m:
Then the wise Hari, with devotion, had the gods perform the auspicious
consecration of Kārttika with waters from all the sacred fords.

2.4.s:
sarvathā samalaṅkṛtya vāsayāmāsa saṅgraham |
kārttikasya vidhiṃ prītyā kārayāmāsa cotsavam ||
2.4.d:
सर्वथा समलङ्कृत्य वासयामास सङ्ग्रहम् ।
कार्त्तिकस्य विधिं प्रीत्या कारयामास चोत्सवम् ॥
2.4.m:
Having adorned him completely, he had the collection settled;
with affection he performed the rite and celebration for Kārttika.

2.4.s:
brahmāṇḍādhipatitvaṃ hi dadau tasmai mudā hariḥ |
cakāra tilakaṃ tasya samānarca suraissaha ||
2.4.d:
ब्रह्माण्डाधिपतित्वं हि ददौ तस्मै मुदा हरिः ।
चकार तिलकं तस्य समानर्च सुरैस्सह ॥
2.4.m:
With joy Hari indeed gave him the lordship over the universe;
he applied the tilaka to him and worshipped him together with the gods.

2.4.s:
praṇamya kārttikaṃ prītyā sarvadevarṣibhiḥ saha |
tuṣṭāva vividhaiḥ stotraiḥ śivarūpaṃ sanātanam ||
2.4.d:
प्रणम्य कार्त्तिकं प्रीत्या सर्वदेवर्षिभिः सह ।
तुष्टाव विविधैः स्तोत्रैः शिवरूपं सनातनम् ॥
2.4.m:
Bowing with affection to Kārttika, together with all the divine sages,
he praised the eternal form of Śiva with various hymns.

2.4.s:
varasiṃhāsanastho hi śuśubhe'tīva kārttikaḥ |
svāmibhāvaṃ samāpanno brahmāṇḍasyāpi pālakaḥ ||
śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ ||
śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ ||
śrīśivamahāpurāṇam ||
dvitīyāyāṃ rudrasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthaḥ kumārakhaṇḍe
2.4.d:
वरसिंहासनस्थो हि शुशुभेऽतीव कार्त्तिकः ।
स्वामिभावं समापन्नो ब्रह्माण्डस्यापि पालकः ॥
श्रीगणेशाय नमः ॥
श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः ॥
श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥
द्वितीयायां रुद्रसंहितायां चतुर्थः कुमारखण्डे
2.4.m:
Seated on the excellent throne, Kārttika shone exceedingly,
having attained the state of Lord, the protector even of the universe.

Thus ends the fifth chapter, titled ‘Description of the Consecration of Kumāra,’ in the Kumārakhaṇḍa, the fourth section of the second Rudrasaṃhitā, in the glorious Śiva Mahāpurāṇa.

2.4.s:
brahmovāca atha tatra sa gāṅgeyo darśayāmāsa sūtikām |
tāmeva śṛṇu suprītyā nārada tvaṃ svabhaktidām ||
2.4.d:
ब्रह्मोवाच अथ तत्र स गाङ्गेयो दर्शयामास सूतिकाम् ।
तामेव शृणु सुप्रीत्या नारद त्वं स्वभक्तिदाम् ॥
2.4.m:
Brahmā said:
Then there that son of Gaṅgā displayed a wonder.
Hear that very wonder with great delight, O Nārada, which grants devotion to him.

2.4.s:
dvija eko nāradākhya ājagāma tadaiva hi |
tatrādhvarakaraḥ śrīmān śaraṇārthaṃ guhasya vai ||
2.4.d:
द्विज एको नारदाख्य आजगाम तदैव हि ।
तत्राध्वरकरः श्रीमान् शरणार्थं गुहस्य वै ॥
2.4.m:
Just then a twice-born named Nārada came there,
an illustrious performer of sacrifices, seeking refuge with Guha.

2.4.s:
sa vipraḥ prāpya nikaṭaṃ kārttikasya prasannadhīḥ |
svābhiprāyaṃ samācakhyau supraṇamya śubhaiḥ stavaiḥ ||
2.4.d:
स विप्रः प्राप्य निकटं कार्त्तिकस्य प्रसन्नधीः ।
स्वाभिप्रायं समाचख्यौ सुप्रणम्य शुभैः स्तवैः ॥
2.4.m:
Reaching the presence of Kārttika, that Brahmin with a cheerful mind
explained his purpose after bowing properly with auspicious hymns.

2.4.s:
vipra uvāca
śṛṇu svāminvaco me'dya kaṣṭaṃ me vinivāraya |
sarvabrahmāṇḍanāthastvamataste śaraṇaṃ gataḥ ||
2.4.d:
विप्र उवाच
शृणु स्वामिन्वचो मेऽद्य कष्टं मे विनिवारय ।
सर्वब्रह्माण्डनाथस्त्वमतस्ते शरणं गतः ॥
2.4.m:
The Brahmin said:
“Listen to my word today, O Master; dispel my distress.
You are the Lord of all the universe; therefore I have come to you for refuge.

2.4.s:
ajamedhādhvaraṃ kartumārambhaṃ kṛtavānaham |
so'jo gato gṛhānme hi troṭayitvā svabandhanam ||
2.4.d:
अजमेधाध्वरं कर्तुमारम्भं कृतवानहम् ।
सोऽजो गतो गृहान्मे हि त्रोटयित्वा स्वबन्धनम् ॥
2.4.m:
I began to perform a goat-sacrifice,
[but] that goat broke its bonds and escaped from my house.

2.4.s:
na jāne sa gataḥ kutrā'nveṣaṇaṃ tatkṛtaṃ bahu |
na prāpto'tassa balavān bhaṅgo bhavati me kratoḥ ||
2.4.d:
न जाने स गतः कुत्राऽन्वेषणं तत्कृतं बहु ।
न प्राप्तोऽतस्स बलवान् भङ्गो भवति मे क्रतोः ॥
2.4.m:
I do not know where it went, though much search was made for it;
that strong goat was not found, and thus my sacrifice is broken.

2.4.s:
tvayi nāthe sati vibho yajñabhaṅgaḥ kathaṃ bhavet |
vicāryyaivā'khileśāna kāmaṃ pūrṇaṃ kuruṣva me ||
2.4.d:
त्वयि नाथे सति विभो यज्ञभङ्गः कथं भवेत् ।
विचार्य्यैवाऽखिलेशान कामं पूर्णं कुरुष्व मे ॥
2.4.m:
While you are my master, O omnipresent Lord, how could my sacrifice be broken?
Reflect upon this, O Lord of all, and fulfill my desire.

2.4.s:
tvāṃ vihāya śaraṇyaṃ kaṃ yāyāṃ śivasuta prabho |
sarvabrahmāṇḍanāthaṃ hi sarvāmarasusevitam ||
2.4.d:
त्वां विहाय शरण्यं कं यायां शिवसुत प्रभो ।
सर्वब्रह्माण्डनाथं हि सर्वामरसुसेवितम् ॥
2.4.m:
Leaving you aside, to what refuge could I go, O son of Śiva, O Lord,
the Lord of all the universe, well served by all the immortals?

2.4.s:
dīnabandhurdayāsindhuḥ susevyo bhaktavatsalaḥ |
haribrahmādidevaiśca sustutaḥ parameśvaraḥ ||
2.4.d:
दीनबन्धुर्दयासिन्धुः सुसेव्यो भक्तवत्सलः ।
हरिब्रह्मादिदेवैश्च सुस्तुतः परमेश्वरः ॥
2.4.m:
Friend of the destitute, ocean of compassion, easy to serve, affectionate toward devotees,
Parameśvara, well praised by the gods headed by Hari and Brahmā,

2.4.s:
pārvatīnandanasskandaḥ paramekaḥ parantapaḥ |
paramātmā'tmadaḥ svāmī satāṃ ca śaraṇārthinām ||
2.4.d:
पार्वतीनन्दनस्स्कन्दः परमेकः परन्तपः ।
परमात्माऽत्मदः स्वामी सतां च शरणार्थिनाम् ॥
2.4.m:
Skanda, son of Pārvatī, the supreme one, tormentor of foes,
the Supreme Self, giver of the self, master of the virtuous who seek refuge,

2.4.s:
dīnānātha maheśa śaṅkarasuta trailokyanātha prabho māyādhīśa samāgato'smi śaraṇaṃ māṃ pāhi viprapriya |
tvaṃ sarvaprabhurānatā'khilavidabrahmādidevaiḥ stutaḥ tvaṃ māyākṛtirātmabhaktasukhado rakṣāparo māyikaḥ ||
2.4.d:
दीनानाथ महेश शङ्करसुत त्रैलोक्यनाथ प्रभो मायाधीश समागतोऽस्मि शरणं मां पाहि विप्रप्रिय ।
त्वं सर्वप्रभुरानताऽखिलविदब्रह्मादिदेवैः स्तुतः त्वं मायाकृतिरात्मभक्तसुखदो रक्षापरो मायिकः ॥

2.4.s:
bhaktaprāṇaguṇākarastriguṇato bhinno'si śambhupriyaḥ śambhuḥ śambhusutaḥ prasannasukhadaḥ saccitsvarūpo mahān |
sarvajñastripuraghnaśaṅkarasutaḥ satpremavaśyaḥsadā ṣaḍvaktraḥ priyasādhurānatapriyaḥ sarveśvaraḥ śaṅkaraḥ |
sādhudrohakaraghna śaṅkaraguro brahmāṇḍanātho prabhuḥ sarveṣāmamarādisevitapado māṃ pāhi sevāpriya ||
2.4.d:
भक्तप्राणगुणाकरस्त्रिगुणतो भिन्नोऽसि शम्भुप्रियः शम्भुः शम्भुसुतः प्रसन्नसुखदः सच्चित्स्वरूपो महान् ।
सर्वज्ञस्त्रिपुरघ्नशङ्करसुतः सत्प्रेमवश्यःसदा षड्वक्त्रः प्रियसाधुरानतप्रियः सर्वेश्वरः शङ्करः ।
साधुद्रोहकरघ्न शङ्करगुरो ब्रह्माण्डनाथो प्रभुः सर्वेषाममरादिसेवितपदो मां पाहि सेवाप्रिय ॥
2.4.m:
Breath of devotees, mine of virtues, you are beyond the three qualities, dear to Śambhu; you are Śambhu, Śambhu's son, cheerful, giving joy, your nature truth and consciousness, the Great One!
All-knowing, son of Śaṅkara who destroyed Tripura, ever subject to true love, six-faced, lover of the virtuous, lover of those who bow, Lord of all, Śaṅkara!
Destroyer of those who harm the virtuous, teacher of Śaṅkara, Lord of the universe, Master whose feet are served by all headed by the immortals, protect me, lover of service!

2.4.s:
vairibhayaṅkara śaṅkara janaśaraṇasya vande tava padapadmaṃ sukhakaraṇasya |
vijñaptiṃ mama karṇe skanda nidhehi nijabhaktiṃ janacetasi sadā vidhehi ||
2.4.d:
वैरिभयङ्कर शङ्कर जनशरणस्य वन्दे तव पदपद्मं सुखकरणस्य ।
विज्ञप्तिं मम कर्णे स्कन्द निधेहि निजभक्तिं जनचेतसि सदा विधेहि ॥
2.4.m:
Terrifying to foes, O Śaṅkara, I praise your lotus feet that bring happiness to him whose refuge is the people!
Take my petition to your ear, O Skanda; establish your devotion in the heart of people forever!”

2.4.s:
karoti kiṃ tasya balī vipakṣo dakṣo'pi pakṣobhayapārśvaguptaḥ |
kiṃ takṣako'pyāmiṣabhakṣako vā tvaṃ rakṣako yasya sadakṣamānaḥ ||
2.4.d:
करोति किं तस्य बली विपक्षो दक्षोऽपि पक्षोभयपार्श्वगुप्तः ।
किं तक्षकोऽप्यामिषभक्षको वा त्वं रक्षको यस्य सदक्षमानः ॥
2.4.m: What can a powerful opponent do to him, even if clever and protected on both flanks? / What can even Takṣaka or a flesh-eater do to him whose protector you are, ever forgiving?

2.4.s:
vibudhagururapi tvāṃ stotumīśo na hi syāt kathaya kathamahaṃ syāṃ mandabuddhirvarārcyaḥ |
śuciraśuciranāryo yādṛśastādṛśo vā padakamalaparāgaṃ skanda te prārthayāmi ||
2.4.d:
विबुधगुरुरपि त्वां स्तोतुमीशो न हि स्यात् कथय कथमहं स्यां मन्दबुद्धिर्वरार्च्यः ।
शुचिरशुचिरनार्यो यादृशस्तादृशो वा पदकमलपरागं स्कन्द ते प्रार्थयामि ॥
2.4.m: Even the preceptor of the gods could not be capable of praising you; tell [me], how could I, of dull intellect, be worthy of worshipping the supreme? / Pure or impure, un-noble, whatever sort [I may be], Skanda, I beg for the pollen of your lotus feet.

2.4.s:
he sarveśvara bhaktavatsala kṛpā-sindho tvadīyo'smyahaṃ bhṛtyaḥ svasya na sevakasya gaṇapa-syāgaḥśataṃ satprabho |
bhaktiṃ kvāpi kṛtāṃ manāgapi vibho jānāsi bhṛtyārtihā tvatto nāstyaparo'vitā na bhagavan matto naraḥ pāmaraḥ ||
2.4.d:
हे सर्वेश्वर भक्तवत्सल कृपा-सिन्धो त्वदीयोऽस्म्यहं भृत्यः स्वस्य न सेवकस्य गणप-स्यागःशतं सत्प्रभो ।
भक्तिं क्वापि कृतां मनागपि विभो जानासि भृत्यार्तिहा त्वत्तो नास्त्यपरोऽविता न भगवन् मत्तो नरः पामरः ॥
2.4.m: O Lord of all, affectionate toward devotees, ocean of mercy, I am your servant; O true Lord, [do] not [regard] the hundred faults of your servant, the lord of attendants. / Knowing even the least devotion done anywhere, O all-pervading one, dispeller of the distress of servants, there is no other protector than you, O Lord, and no man more wretched than I.

2.4.s:
kalyāṇakarttā kalikalmaṣaghnaḥ kuberabandhuḥ karuṇārdracittaḥ |
triṣaṭkanetro rasavaktraśobhī yajñaṃ prapūrṇaṃ kuru me guha tvam ||
2.4.d:
कल्याणकर्त्ता कलिकल्मषघ्नः कुबेरबन्धुः करुणार्द्रचित्तः ।
त्रिषट्कनेत्रो रसवक्त्रशोभी यज्ञं प्रपूर्णं कुरु मे गुह त्वम् ॥
2.4.m: Maker of welfare, destroyer of the sins of the Kali age, friend of Kubera, with a heart moist with compassion, / having three times six eyes, shining with six faces: O Guha, make my sacrifice complete!

2.4.s:
rakṣakastvaṃ trilokasya śaraṇāgatavatsalaḥ |
yajñakarttā yajñabharttā harase vighnakāriṇām ||
2.4.d:
रक्षकस्त्वं त्रिलोकस्य शरणागतवत्सलः ।
यज्ञकर्त्ता यज्ञभर्त्ता हरसे विघ्नकारिणाम् ॥
2.4.m: You are the protector of the three worlds, affectionate to those who have come for refuge. / You are the maker of sacrifices, the maintainer of sacrifices; you take away [the lives] of those who cause obstacles.

2.4.s:
vighnavāraṇa sādhūnāṃ sarga kāraṇa sarvataḥ |
pūrṇaṃ kuru mameśāna sutayajña namostu te ||
2.4.d:
विघ्नवारण साधूनां सर्ग कारण सर्वतः ।
पूर्णं कुरु ममेशान सुतयज्ञ नमोस्तु ते ॥
2.4.m: O warder of obstacles for the virtuous, cause of creation everywhere! / O son of Īśāna, make my sacrifice complete; homage be to you!

2.4.s:
sarvatrātā skanda hi tvaṃ sarvajñātā tvameva hi |
sarveśvarastvamīśāno niveśasakalā'vanaḥ ||
2.4.d:
सर्वत्राता स्कन्द हि त्वं सर्वज्ञाता त्वमेव हि ।
सर्वेश्वरस्त्वमीशानो निवेशसकलाऽवनः ॥
2.4.m: For you are the protector of all, Skanda; you alone are the knower of all. / You are the Lord of all, the ruler, the resting place and protection of all.

2.4.s:
saṅgītajñastvamevāsi vedavijñaḥ paraḥ prabhuḥ |
sarvasthātā vidhātā tvaṃ devadevaḥ satāṃ gatiḥ ||
2.4.d:
सङ्गीतज्ञस्त्वमेवासि वेदविज्ञः परः प्रभुः ।
सर्वस्थाता विधाता त्वं देवदेवः सतां गतिः ॥
2.4.m: You alone are the knower of music, the knower of the Veda, the supreme Lord. / You dwell in all, you are the ordainer, the God of gods, the refuge of the good.

2.4.s:
bhavānīnandanaḥ śambhutanayo vayunaḥ svarāṭ |
dhyātā dhyeyaḥ pitṝṇāṃ hi pitā yoniḥ sadātmanām ||
2.4.d:
भवानीनन्दनः शम्भुतनयो वयुनः स्वराट् ।
ध्याता ध्येयः पितॄणां हि पिता योनिः सदात्मनाम् ॥
2.4.m: The son of Bhavānī, the son of Śambhu, wisdom, the sovereign ruler, / the meditator, the object of meditation, the father of the ancestors, the origin of the righteous.

2.4.s:
brahmovāca ityākarṇya vacastasya devasamrāṭ śivātmajaḥ |
svagaṇaṃ vīrabāhvākhyaṃ preṣayāmāsa tatkṛte ||
2.4.d:
ब्रह्मोवाच इत्याकर्ण्य वचस्तस्य देवसम्राट् शिवात्मजः ।
स्वगणं वीरबाह्वाख्यं प्रेषयामास तत्कृते ॥
2.4.m: Brahmā said: / Having heard his speech, the emperor of the gods, the son of Śiva, / dispatched his attendant named Vīrabāhu for that purpose.

2.4.s:
tadājñayā vīrabāhustadanveṣaṇahetave |
praṇamya svāminaṃ bhaktyā mahāvīro drutaṃ yayau ||
2.4.d:
तदाज्ञया वीरबाहुस्तदन्वेषणहेतवे ।
प्रणम्य स्वामिनं भक्त्या महावीरो द्रुतं ययौ ॥
2.4.m: By his command, for the sake of searching for it, / that great hero, having bowed down to his master with devotion, departed swiftly.

2.4.s:
anveṣaṇaṃ cakārāsau sarvabrahmāṇḍagolake |
na prāpa tamajaṃ kutra śuśrāva tadupadravam ||
2.4.d:
अन्वेषणं चकारासौ सर्वब्रह्माण्डगोलके ।
न प्राप तमजं कुत्र शुश्राव तदुपद्रवम् ॥
2.4.m: He carried out a search throughout the entire sphere of the universe; / he did not find that goat anywhere, [though] he heard of its havoc.

2.4.s:
jagāmā'tha sa vaikuṇṭhaṃ tatrā'jaṃ pradadarśa tam |
upadravaṃ prakurvantaṃ galayūpaṃ mahābalam ||
2.4.d:
जगामाऽथ स वैकुण्ठं तत्राऽजं प्रददर्श तम् ।
उपद्रवं प्रकुर्वन्तं गलयूपं महाबलम् ॥
2.4.m: Then he went to Vaikuṇṭha, and there he saw that goat, / exceedingly strong, wreaking havoc, with the sacrificial post tied to its neck.

2.4.s:
dhṛtvā taṃ śṛṅgayorvīro dharṣayitvātivegataḥ |
ānināya svāmipuro vikurvantaṃ ravaṃ bahu ||
2.4.d:
धृत्वा तं शृङ्गयोर्वीरो धर्षयित्वातिवेगतः ।
आनिनाय स्वामिपुरो विकुर्वन्तं रवं बहु ॥
2.4.m: Seizing it by the horns, the hero overpowered it with great speed / and brought it before his master, while it made loud cries.

2.4.s:
dṛṣṭvā taṃ kārttikasso'ramāruroha sa taṃ prabhuḥ |
dhṛtabrahmāṇḍagarimā mahāsūtikaro guhaḥ ||
2.4.d:
दृष्ट्वा तं कार्त्तिकस्सोऽरमारुरोह स तं प्रभुः ।
धृतब्रह्माण्डगरिमा महासूतिकरो गुहः ॥
2.4.m: Seeing it, Kārttika, the Lord, quickly mounted it— / Guha, who bore the weight of the universe, the great creator.

2.4.s:
muhūrtamātratasso'jo brahmāṇḍaṃ sakalaṃ mune |
babhrāma śrama evāśu punastatsthānamāgataḥ ||
2.4.d:
मुहूर्तमात्रतस्सोऽजो ब्रह्माण्डं सकलं मुने ।
बभ्राम श्रम एवाशु पुनस्तत्स्थानमागतः ॥
2.4.m: In mere moments, O sage, that goat traversed the entire universe; / worn out, it quickly returned to that very place.

2.4.s:
tata uttīrya sa svāmī samuvāsa svamāsanam |
so'jaḥ sthitastu tatraiva sa nārada uvāca tam ||
2.4.d:
तत उत्तीर्य स स्वामी समुवास स्वमासनम् ।
सोऽजः स्थितस्तु तत्रैव स नारद उवाच तम् ॥
2.4.m: Then, dismounting, the master sat upon his own seat; / and as that goat stood right there, Nārada said to him:

2.4.s:
nārada uvāca
namaste deva deveśa dehi me'jaṃ kṛpānidhe |
kuryāmadhvaramānandātsakhāyaṃ kuru māmaho ||
2.4.d:
नारद उवाच
नमस्ते देव देवेश देहि मेऽजं कृपानिधे ।
कुर्यामध्वरमानन्दात्सखायं कुरु मामहो ॥
2.4.m: Nārada said: / Homage to you, O God, Lord of gods! Grant me the goat, O ocean of mercy! / With joy I will perform the sacrifice; oh, make me your companion!

2.4.s:
kārttika uvāca
vadhayogyo na viprā'jaḥ svagṛhaṃ gaccha nārada |
pūrṇo'stu te'dhvaraḥ sarvaḥ prasādādeva me kṛtaḥ ||
2.4.d:
कार्त्तिक उवाच
वधयोग्यो न विप्राऽजः स्वगृहं गच्छ नारद ।
पूर्णोऽस्तु तेऽध्वरः सर्वः प्रसादादेव मे कृतः ॥
2.4.m: Kārttika said: / O twice-born, the goat is not fit to be killed; go to your own home, Nārada! / By my favor alone, your entire sacrifice is completed.

2.4.s:
brahmovāca ityākarṇya dvijaḥsvāmī vacanaṃ prītamānasaḥ |
jagāma svālayaṃ dattvā tasmā āśiṣamuttamām ||
śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ ||
śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ ||
śrīśivamahāpurāṇam ||
dvitīyāyāṃ rudrasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthaḥ kumārakhaṇḍe
2.4.d:
ब्रह्मोवाच इत्याकर्ण्य द्विजःस्वामी वचनं प्रीतमानसः ।
जगाम स्वालयं दत्त्वा तस्मा आशिषमुत्तमाम् ॥
श्रीगणेशाय नमः ॥
श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः ॥
श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥
द्वितीयायां रुद्रसंहितायां चतुर्थः कुमारखण्डे
2.4.m:
Brahmā said: / Having heard the words of the Master, the twice-born, his mind delighted, / went to his own abode after giving him an excellent blessing.

Thus ends the sixth chapter, named 'Description of the Wondrous Deeds of Kumāra,' in the Kumārakhaṇḍa, the fourth [section] of the second [part], the Rudrasaṃhitā, in the glorious Śiva Mahāpurāṇa.

2.4.s:
brahmovāca haryyādayassurāste ca dṛṣṭvā taccaritaṃ vibhoḥ |
suprasannā babhūvurhi viśvāsāsaktamānasāḥ ||
2.4.d:
ब्रह्मोवाच हर्य्यादयस्सुरास्ते च दृष्ट्वा तच्चरितं विभोः ।
सुप्रसन्ना बभूवुर्हि विश्वासासक्तमानसाः ॥
2.4.m: Brahmā said: / Seeing that deed of the Lord, the gods, Hari and the others, / became exceedingly delighted, their minds attached with trust.

2.4.s:
valgantaḥ kurvato nādaṃ bhāvitāśśivatejasā |
kumārante puraskṛtya tārakaṃ hantumāyayuḥ ||
2.4.d:
वल्गन्तः कुर्वतो नादं भाविताश्शिवतेजसा ।
कुमारन्ते पुरस्कृत्य तारकं हन्तुमाययुः ॥
2.4.m: Leaping and shouting, inspired by the majesty of Śiva, / placing Kumāra at their head, they marched to slay Tāraka.

2.4.s:
devānāmudyamaṃ śrutvā tārako'pi mahābalaḥ |
sainyena mahatā sadyo yayau yoddhuṃ surān prati ||
2.4.d:
देवानामुद्यमं श्रुत्वा तारकोऽपि महाबलः ।
सैन्येन महता सद्यो ययौ योद्धुं सुरान् प्रति ॥
2.4.m: Hearing of the endeavor of the gods, Tāraka also, of great strength, / immediately marched with a great army against the gods to fight.

2.4.s:
devā dṛṣṭvā samāyāntaṃ tārakasya mahābalam |
balena bahukurvantaḥ siṃhanādaṃ visismiyuḥ ||
2.4.d:
देवा दृष्ट्वा समायान्तं तारकस्य महाबलम् ।
बलेन बहुकुर्वन्तः सिंहनादं विसिस्मियुः ॥
2.4.m: Seeing the great army of Tāraka approaching, / the gods, roaring like lions with their forces, were amazed.

2.4.s:
tadā nabho'ṅganā vāṇīṃ jagādopari satvaram |
śaṅkarapreritā sadyo haryādīnakhilān surān ||
2.4.d:
तदा नभोऽङ्गना वाणीं जगादोपरि सत्वरम् ।
शङ्करप्रेरिता सद्यो हर्यादीनखिलान् सुरान् ॥
2.4.m: Then a maiden of the sky swiftly spoke a voice from above, / sent at once by Śaṅkara to all the gods, Hari and the others:

2.4.s:
vyomavāṇyuvāca
kumāraṃ ca puraskṛtya surā yūyaṃ samudyatāḥ |
daityānvijitya saṅgrāme jayino'tha bhaviṣyatha ||
2.4.d:
व्योमवाण्युवाच
कुमारं च पुरस्कृत्य सुरा यूयं समुद्यताः ।
दैत्यान्विजित्य सङ्ग्रामे जयिनोऽथ भविष्यथ ॥
2.4.m: The voice from the sky said: / Placing Kumāra at your head, O gods, march forth prepared; / having conquered the Daityas in battle, you will then be victorious.

2.4.s:
brahmovāca vācaṃ tu khecarīṃ śrutvā devāḥ sarve samutsukāḥ |
vīraśabdān prakurvanto nirbhayā hyabhavaṃstadā ||
2.4.d:
ब्रह्मोवाच वाचं तु खेचरीं श्रुत्वा देवाः सर्वे समुत्सुकाः ।
वीरशब्दान् प्रकुर्वन्तो निर्भया ह्यभवंस्तदा ॥
2.4.m: Brahmā said: / Hearing that speech traversing the sky, all the gods became eager; / uttering heroic shouts, they then became fearless.

2.4.s:
kumāraṃ ca puraskṛtya sarve te gatasādhvasāḥ |
yoddhukāmāḥ surā jagmurmahīsāgarasaṅgamam ||
2.4.d:
कुमारं च पुरस्कृत्य सर्वे ते गतसाध्वसाः ।
योद्धुकामाः सुरा जग्मुर्महीसागरसङ्गमम् ॥
2.4.m: Placing Kumāra at their head, all of them, freed from fear / and eager to fight, the gods went to the confluence of the Mahī and the ocean.

2.4.s:
ājagāma drutaṃ tatra yatra devāḥ sa tārakaḥ |
sainyena mahatā sārddhaṃ asurairbahubhirvṛtaḥ ||
2.4.d:
आजगाम द्रुतं तत्र यत्र देवाः स तारकः ।
सैन्येन महता सार्द्धं असुरैर्बहुभिर्वृतः ॥
2.4.m: Tāraka came quickly there where the gods were, / along with a great army, surrounded by many Asuras.

2.4.s:
raṇadundubhayo neduḥ pralayāmbudaniḥsvanāḥ |
karkaśāni ca vādyāni parāṇi ca tadāgame ||
2.4.d:
रणदुन्दुभयो नेदुः प्रलयाम्बुदनिःस्वनाः ।
कर्कशानि च वाद्यानि पराणि च तदागमे ॥
2.4.m: War drums sounded with the roar of clouds at the dissolution [of the world], / and upon his arrival, other harsh musical instruments [were played].

2.4.s:
garjamānāstadā daityāstārakeṇāsureṇa ha |
kampayanto bhuvaṃ pādakramairvalgunakārakāḥ ||
2.4.d:
गर्जमानास्तदा दैत्यास्तारकेणासुरेण ह ।
कम्पयन्तो भुवं पादक्रमैर्वल्गुनकारकाः ॥
2.4.m: Roaring then, the Daityas, led by the Asura Tāraka, / making bounds, shook the earth with their strides.

2.4.s:
tacchrutvā ravamatyugraṃ sarve devā vinirbhayāḥ |
aikapadyena cottasthuryoddhukāmāśca tārakam ||
2.4.d:
तच्छ्रुत्वा रवमत्युग्रं सर्वे देवा विनिर्भयाः ।
ऐकपद्येन चोत्तस्थुर्योद्धुकामाश्च तारकम् ॥
2.4.m: Hearing that extremely terrible roar, all the gods, entirely fearless / and eager to fight Tāraka, stood up together at once.

2.4.s:
gajamāropya devendraḥ kumāraṃ hyagrato'bhavat |
surasainyena mahatā lokapālaiḥ samāvṛtaḥ ||
2.4.d:
गजमारोप्य देवेन्द्रः कुमारं ह्यग्रतोऽभवत् ।
सुरसैन्येन महता लोकपालैः समावृतः ॥
2.4.m: Mounting Kumāra on an elephant, Devendra was in front, / surrounded by a great army of gods and the world protectors.

2.4.s:
tadā dundubhayo nedurbherītūryāṇyanekaśaḥ |
vīṇāveṇumṛdaṅgāni tathā gandharvanissvanāḥ ||
2.4.d:
तदा दुन्दुभयो नेदुर्भेरीतूर्याण्यनेकशः ।
वीणावेणुमृदङ्गानि तथा गन्धर्वनिस्स्वनाः ॥
2.4.m: Then kettledrums sounded, and kettle-drums and trumpets in great numbers, / lutes, flutes, and mṛdaṅgas, as well as the sounds of Gandharvas.

2.4.s:
gajaṃ dattvā mahendrāya kumāro yānamāruhat |
anekāścaryasambhūtaṃ nānāratnasamanvitam ||
2.4.d:
गजं दत्त्वा महेन्द्राय कुमारो यानमारुहत् ।
अनेकाश्चर्यसम्भूतं नानारत्नसमन्वितम् ॥
2.4.m: Having given the elephant to Mahendra, Kumāra mounted a chariot / produced with many wonders and endowed with various gems.

2.4.s:
vimānamāruhya tadā mahāyaśāḥ sa śāṅkariḥsarvaguṇairupetaḥ |
śriyā sametaḥ parayā babhau mahān saṃvījyamānaścamarairmahāprabhaiḥ ||
2.4.d:
विमानमारुह्य तदा महायशाः स शाङ्करिःसर्वगुणैरुपेतः ।
श्रिया समेतः परया बभौ महान् संवीज्यमानश्चमरैर्महाप्रभैः ॥
2.4.m: Having mounted the aerial chariot, the son of Śaṅkara of great renown, endowed with all virtues, / accompanied by supreme splendor, shone great, being fanned with chowries of immense radiance.

2.4.s:
prācetasaṃ chatramatīvasuprabhaṃ ratnairupetaṃ vividhairvirājitam |
dhṛtaṃ tadā tacca kumāramūrdhni vai hyanantacāndraiḥ kiraṇairmahāprabhaiḥ ||
2.4.d:
प्राचेतसं छत्रमतीवसुप्रभं रत्नैरुपेतं विविधैर्विराजितम् ।
धृतं तदा तच्च कुमारमूर्ध्नि वै ह्यनन्तचान्द्रैः किरणैर्महाप्रभैः ॥
2.4.m: A parasol belonging to Varuṇa, of extremely great luster, endowed with various gems and radiant, / with endless moon-like rays of great brilliance, was then held over Kumāra's head.

2.4.s:
militāste tadā sarve devāḥ śakrapurogamāḥ |
svaiḥ svairbalaiḥ parivṛtā yuddhakāmā mahābalāḥ ||
2.4.d:
मिलितास्ते तदा सर्वे देवाः शक्रपुरोगमाः ।
स्वैः स्वैर्बलैः परिवृता युद्धकामा महाबलाः ॥
2.4.m: Then all those gods, led by Śakra, assembled, / surrounded by their respective forces, eager for battle, of great strength.

2.4.s:
evaṃ devāśca daityāśca yoddhukāmāḥ sthitā bhuvi |
sainyena mahatā tena vyūhaṃ kṛtvā pṛthak pṛthak ||
2.4.d:
एवं देवाश्च दैत्याश्च योद्धुकामाः स्थिता भुवि ।
सैन्येन महता तेन व्यूहं कृत्वा पृथक् पृथक् ॥
2.4.m: Thus the gods and Daityas, eager to fight, stood on the earth / with those great armies, forming battle arrays separately.

2.4.s:
te sene suradaityānāṃ śuśubhāte parasparam |
hantukāme tadānyonyaṃ stūyamāne ca bandibhiḥ ||
2.4.d:
ते सेने सुरदैत्यानां शुशुभाते परस्परम् ।
हन्तुकामे तदान्योन्यं स्तूयमाने च बन्दिभिः ॥
2.4.m: Those two armies of the gods and the Daityas looked splendid facing each other, / eager to kill one another, praised by bards.

2.4.s:
ubhe sene tadā teṣāmagarjetāṃ vanopame |
bhayaṅkare'tyavīrāṇāmitareṣāṃ sukhāvahe ||
2.4.d:
उभे सेने तदा तेषामगर्जेतां वनोपमे ।
भयङ्करेऽत्यवीराणामितरेषां सुखावहे ॥
2.4.m: Then both their armies roared like a forest, / terrifying to cowards, bringing joy to the others.

2.4.s:
etasminnantare tatra balonmattāḥ parasparam |
daityā devā mahāvīrā yuyudhuḥ krodhavihvalāḥ ||
2.4.d:
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे तत्र बलोन्मत्ताः परस्परम् ।
दैत्या देवा महावीरा युयुधुः क्रोधविह्वलाः ॥
2.4.m:
Meanwhile, drunk with power, those great heroes,
the demons and the gods, agitated with anger, fought one another there.

2.4.s:
āsītsutumulaṃ yuddhaṃ devadaityasamākulam |
ruṇḍamuṇḍāṅkitaṃ sarvaṃ kṣaṇena samapadyata ||
2.4.d:
आसीत्सुतुमुलं युद्धं देवदैत्यसमाकुलम् ।
रुण्डमुण्डाङ्कितं सर्वं क्षणेन समपद्यत ॥
2.4.m: A tumultuous battle took place, filled with gods and Daityas; / in an instant, everything became marked with trunks and severed heads.

2.4.s:
bhūmau nipatitāstatra śataśo'tha sahasraśaḥ |
nikṛttāṅgā mahāśastrairnihatā vīrasammatāḥ ||
2.4.d:
भूमौ निपतितास्तत्र शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः ।
निकृत्ताङ्गा महाशस्त्रैर्निहता वीरसम्मताः ॥
2.4.m: Fallen upon the ground there by hundreds and thousands, / their limbs cut to pieces by great weapons, acclaimed warriors lay slain.

2.4.s:
keṣāñcidbāhavaśchinnāḥ khaḍgapātaiḥ sudāruṇaiḥ |
keṣāñcidūravaśchinnā vīrāṇāṃ mānināṃ mṛdhe ||
2.4.d:
केषाञ्चिद्बाहवश्छिन्नाः खड्गपातैः सुदारुणैः ।
केषाञ्चिदूरवश्छिन्ना वीराणां मानिनां मृधे ॥
2.4.m: The arms of some were severed by dreadful sword strokes; / the thighs of some proud heroes were cut off in the battle.

2.4.s:
kecinmathitasarvāṅgā gadābhirmudgaraistathā |
kecinnirbhinnahṛdayāḥ pāśairbhallaiśca pātitāḥ ||
2.4.d:
केचिन्मथितसर्वाङ्गा गदाभिर्मुद्गरैस्तथा ।
केचिन्निर्भिन्नहृदयाः पाशैर्भल्लैश्च पातिताः ॥
2.4.m: Some had all their limbs crushed by clubs and mallets; / some, their chests pierced by fetters and javelins, were struck down.

2.4.s:
kecidvidāritāḥ pṛṣṭhe kuntairṛṣṭibhiraṅkuśaiḥ |
chinnānyapi śirāṃsyeva patitāni ca bhūtale ||
2.4.d:
केचिद्विदारिताः पृष्ठे कुन्तैरृष्टिभिरङ्कुशैः ।
छिन्नान्यपि शिरांस्येव पतितानि च भूतले ॥
2.4.m: Some were torn open in the back by spears, darts, and goads; / severed heads also fell upon the surface of the earth.

2.4.s:
bahūni ca kabandhāni nṛtyamānāni tatra vai |
valgamānāni śataśo udyatāstrakarāṇi ca ||
2.4.d:
बहूनि च कबन्धानि नृत्यमानानि तत्र वै ।
वल्गमानानि शतशो उद्यतास्त्रकराणि च ॥
2.4.m: And many headless trunks danced about there indeed, / leaping by the hundreds, with weapons raised in their hands.

2.4.s:
nadyaḥ pravartitāstatra śataśo'sṛṅvahāstadā |
bhūtapretādayastatra śataśaśca samāgatāḥ ||
gomāyavaśśivāḥ tatra bhakṣayantaḥ palaṃ bahu |
tathā gṛdhravaṭā śyenā vāyasā māṃsabhakṣakāḥ ||
bubhujuḥ patitānāṃ ca palāni subahūni vai | 30 ||
2.4.d:
नद्यः प्रवर्तितास्तत्र शतशोऽसृङ्वहास्तदा ।
भूतप्रेतादयस्तत्र शतशश्च समागताः ॥
गोमायवश्शिवाः तत्र भक्षयन्तः पलं बहु ।
तथा गृध्रवटा श्येना वायसा मांसभक्षकाः ॥
बुभुजुः पतितानां च पलानि सुबहूनि वै । 30 ॥

2.4.s:
etasminnantare tatra tārakākhyo mahābalaḥ |
sainyena mahatā sadyo yayau yoddhuṃ surān prati ||
2.4.d:
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे तत्र तारकाख्यो महाबलः ।
सैन्येन महता सद्यो ययौ योद्धुं सुरान् प्रति ॥
2.4.m: In the meantime, the mighty one named Tāraka / immediately set forth with a vast army to fight against the gods.

2.4.s:
devā dṛṣṭvā samāyāntaṃ tārakaṃ yuddhadurmadam |
yoddhukāmaṃ tadā sadyo yayuḥ śakrādayastadā |
babhūvātha mahonnādaḥsenayorubhayorapi ||
2.4.d:
देवा दृष्ट्वा समायान्तं तारकं युद्धदुर्मदम् ।
योद्धुकामं तदा सद्यो ययुः शक्रादयस्तदा ।
बभूवाथ महोन्नादःसेनयोरुभयोरपि ॥
2.4.m: Seeing Tāraka approaching, intoxicated with battle, / wishing to fight, Śakra and the others then immediately went out; / then a great clamor arose from both armies.

2.4.s:
athābhūd dvandvayuddhaṃ hi surāsuravimardanam |
yaṃ dṛṣṭvā harṣitā vīrāḥ klībāśca bhayamāgatāḥ ||
2.4.d:
अथाभूद् द्वन्द्वयुद्धं हि सुरासुरविमर्दनम् ।
यं दृष्ट्वा हर्षिता वीराः क्लीबाश्च भयमागताः ॥
2.4.m: Then indeed single combats began, crushing gods and asuras, / seeing which warriors rejoiced and cowards grew terrified.

2.4.s:
tārako yuyudhe yuddhe śakreṇa ditijo balī |
agninā saha saṃhrādo jambhenaiva yamaḥ svayam ||
2.4.d:
तारको युयुधे युद्धे शक्रेण दितिजो बली ।
अग्निना सह संह्रादो जम्भेनैव यमः स्वयम् ॥
2.4.m: The mighty son of Diti, Tāraka, fought in battle against Śakra, / Saṃhrāda with Agni, and Yama himself with Jambha;

2.4.s:
mahāprabhurnairṛtena pāśī saha balena ca |
suvīro vāyunā sārdhaṃ pavamānena guhyarāṭ ||
2.4.d:
महाप्रभुर्नैरृतेन पाशी सह बलेन च ।
सुवीरो वायुना सार्धं पवमानेन गुह्यराट् ॥
2.4.m: Mahāprabhu with Nairṛta, and the holder of the noose [Varuṇa] with Bala, / Suvīra with Vāyu, and the king of Guhyakas with Pavamāna;

2.4.s:
īśānena samaṃ śambhuryuyudhe raṇavittamaḥ |
śumbhaḥ śeṣeṇa yuyudhe kumbhaścandreṇa dānavaḥ ||
2.4.d:
ईशानेन समं शम्भुर्युयुधे रणवित्तमः ।
शुम्भः शेषेण युयुधे कुम्भश्चन्द्रेण दानवः ॥
2.4.m: Śambhu, foremost among battle experts, fought together with Īśāna; / Śumbha fought with Śeṣa, and the Dānava Kumbha with Candra;

2.4.s:
kuñjaro mihireṇājau mahābalaparākramaḥ |
yuyudhe paramāstraiśca nānāyuddhaviśāradaḥ ||
2.4.d:
कुञ्जरो मिहिरेणाजौ महाबलपराक्रमः ।
युयुधे परमास्त्रैश्च नानायुद्धविशारदः ॥
2.4.m: Kuñjara, possessed of great strength and prowess, skilled in various combats, / fought in the fray against Mihira with supreme weapons.

2.4.s:
evaṃ dvandvena yuddhena mahatā ca surāsurāḥ |
saṅgare yuyudhuḥsarve balena kṛtaniścayāḥ ||
2.4.d:
एवं द्वन्द्वेन युद्धेन महता च सुरासुराः ।
सङ्गरे युयुधुःसर्वे बलेन कृतनिश्चयाः ॥
2.4.m: Thus in great single combats the gods and asuras, / resolute through their strength, all fought on the battlefield.

2.4.s:
anyonyaṃ sparddhamānāste'marā daityā mahābalāḥ |
tasmindevāsure yuddhe durjayā abhavanmune ||
2.4.d:
अन्योन्यं स्पर्द्धमानास्तेऽमरा दैत्या महाबलाः ।
तस्मिन्देवासुरे युद्धे दुर्जया अभवन्मुने ॥
2.4.m: Vying with one another, those mighty immortals and Daityas / became unconquerable in that war of gods and asuras, O sage.

2.4.s:
tadā ca teṣāṃ suradānavānāṃ babhūva yuddhaṃ tumulaṃ jayaiṣiṇām |
sukhāvahaṃ vīramanasvināṃ vai bhayāvahaṃ caiva tathetareṣām ||
2.4.d:
तदा च तेषां सुरदानवानां बभूव युद्धं तुमुलं जयैषिणाम् ।
सुखावहं वीरमनस्विनां वै भयावहं चैव तथेतरेषाम् ॥
2.4.m: And then between those gods and Dānavas desiring victory, a tumultuous battle took place, / bringing joy indeed to heroic, high-minded men, and likewise terror to the rest.

2.4.s:
mahī mahāraudratarā vinaṣṭakaiḥ surāsurairvai patitairanekaśaḥ |
tasminnagamyātibhayānakā tadā jātā mahāsaukhyavahā manasvinām ||
śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ ||
śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ ||
śrīśivamahāpurāṇam ||
dvitīyāyāṃ rudrasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthaḥ kumārakhaṇḍe
2.4.d:
मही महारौद्रतरा विनष्टकैः सुरासुरैर्वै पतितैरनेकशः ।
तस्मिन्नगम्यातिभयानका तदा जाता महासौख्यवहा मनस्विनाम् ॥
श्रीगणेशाय नमः ॥
श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः ॥
श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥
द्वितीयायां रुद्रसंहितायां चतुर्थः कुमारखण्डे
2.4.m:
The earth became exceedingly terrible with destroyed gods and asuras fallen in numbers; / impassable and intensely frightful then, it brought great delight to the high-minded.

Thus ends the seventh chapter, titled “Description of the Beginning of the Battle,” in the Kumārakhaṇḍa, the fourth section of the second [part], the Rudrasaṃhitā, in the glorious Śiva Mahāpurāṇa.

2.4.s:
brahmovāca iti te varṇitastāta devadānava senayoḥ |
saṅgrāmastumulo'tīva tatprabhvoḥ śṛṇu nārada ||
2.4.d:
ब्रह्मोवाच इति ते वर्णितस्तात देवदानव सेनयोः ।
सङ्ग्रामस्तुमुलोऽतीव तत्प्रभ्वोः शृणु नारद ॥
2.4.m: Brahmā said: / Thus has the exceedingly tumultuous battle between the armies of the gods and Dānavas / been described to you, my dear child; now hear about its champions, O Nārada.

2.4.s:
evaṃ yuddhe'titumule devadānavasaṅkṣaye |
tārakeṇaiva devendraḥ śaktyā paramayā saha ||
2.4.d:
एवं युद्धेऽतितुमुले देवदानवसङ्क्षये ।
तारकेणैव देवेन्द्रः शक्त्या परमया सह ॥
2.4.m: While the battle was thus exceedingly tumultuous, causing the destruction of gods and Dānavas, / the lord of the gods [was struck] by Tāraka with a supreme spear.

2.4.s:
sadyaḥ papāta nāgāśca dharaṇyāṃ mūrcchito'bhavat |
paraṃ kaśmalamāpede vajradhārī sureśvaraḥ ||
2.4.d:
सद्यः पपात नागाश्च धरण्यां मूर्च्छितोऽभवत् ।
परं कश्मलमापेदे वज्रधारी सुरेश्वरः ॥
2.4.m: He instantly fell from his elephant onto the earth and fainted; / the wielder of the thunderbolt, the lord of the gods, fell into a deep stupor.

2.4.s:
tathaiva lokapāḥ sarve'suraiśca balavattaraiḥ |
parājitā raṇe tāta mahāraṇaviśāradaiḥ ||
2.4.d:
तथैव लोकपाः सर्वेऽसुरैश्च बलवत्तरैः ।
पराजिता रणे तात महारणविशारदैः ॥
2.4.m: In the same manner, all the guardians of the worlds, my dear child, were defeated in battle / by the stronger asuras, who were skilled in great warfare.

2.4.s:
anye'pi nirjarā daityairyuddhyamānāḥ parājitāḥ |
asahanto hi tattejaḥ palāyanaparāyaṇāḥ ||
2.4.d:
अन्येऽपि निर्जरा दैत्यैर्युद्ध्यमानाः पराजिताः ।
असहन्तो हि तत्तेजः पलायनपरायणाः ॥
2.4.m: Other gods as well, fighting against the Daityas, were defeated; / unable to endure their brilliance, they were bent on flight.

2.4.s:
jagarjurasurāstatra jayinaḥ sukṛtodyamāḥ |
siṃhanādaṃ prakurvantaḥ kolāhalaparāyaṇāḥ ||
2.4.d:
जगर्जुरसुरास्तत्र जयिनः सुकृतोद्यमाः ।
सिंहनादं प्रकुर्वन्तः कोलाहलपरायणाः ॥
2.4.m: The victorious asuras roared there, their efforts successful, / letting out lion-roars and indulging in uproarious shouting.

2.4.s:
etasminnantare tatra vīrabhadro ruṣānvitaḥ |
āsasāda gaṇairvīraistārakaṃ vīramāninam ||
2.4.d:
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे तत्र वीरभद्रो रुषान्वितः ।
आससाद गणैर्वीरैस्तारकं वीरमानिनम् ॥
2.4.m: In the meantime, Vīrabhadra, filled with wrath, / together with his heroic attendants, approached Tāraka, who deemed himself a hero.

2.4.s:
nirjarān pṛṣṭhataḥ kṛtvā śivakopodbhavo balī |
tatsammukho babhūvātha yoddhukāmo gaṇāgraṇīḥ ||
2.4.d:
निर्जरान् पृष्ठतः कृत्वा शिवकोपोद्भवो बली ।
तत्सम्मुखो बभूवाथ योद्धुकामो गणाग्रणीः ॥
2.4.m: Putting the gods behind him, that mighty one born of Śiva's wrath, / the leader of the attendants, stepped in front of him, eager to fight.

2.4.s:
tadā te pramathāḥ sarve daityāśca paramotsavāḥ |
yuyudhuḥ saṃyuge'nyonyaṃ prasaktāśca mahāraṇe ||
2.4.d:
तदा ते प्रमथाः सर्वे दैत्याश्च परमोत्सवाः ।
युयुधुः संयुगेऽन्योन्यं प्रसक्ताश्च महारणे ॥
2.4.m: Then all those Pramathas and Daityas, exceedingly joyful, / fought one another in conflict, deeply engaged in the great battle.

2.4.s:
triśūlairṛṣṭibhiḥ pāśaiḥ khaḍgaiḥ paraśupaṭṭiśaiḥ |
nijaghnuḥsamare'nyo'nyaṃ raṇe raṇaviśāradāḥ ||
2.4.d:
त्रिशूलैरृष्टिभिः पाशैः खड्गैः परशुपट्टिशैः ।
निजघ्नुःसमरेऽन्योऽन्यं रणे रणविशारदाः ॥
2.4.m: With tridents, darts, nooses, swords, axes, and sharp iron bars, / those experts in battle struck one another down in combat.

2.4.s:
tārako vīrabhadreṇa sa triśūlāhato bhṛśam |
papāta sahasā bhūmau kṣaṇaṃ mūrchāpariplutaḥ ||
2.4.d:
तारको वीरभद्रेण स त्रिशूलाहतो भृशम् ।
पपात सहसा भूमौ क्षणं मूर्छापरिप्लुतः ॥
2.4.m: Tāraka, severely struck with a trident by Vīrabhadra, / suddenly fell to the earth, overwhelmed for a moment by a swoon.

2.4.s:
utthāya sa drutaṃ vīrastārako daityasattamaḥ |
labdhasaṃjño balācchaktyā vīrabhadraṃ jaghāna ha ||
2.4.d:
उत्थाय स द्रुतं वीरस्तारको दैत्यसत्तमः ।
लब्धसंज्ञो बलाच्छक्त्या वीरभद्रं जघान ह ॥
2.4.m: Quickly rising, that heroic Tāraka, the best of the Daityas, / regained consciousness and forcefully struck Vīrabhadra with his spear.

2.4.s:
vīrabhadrastathā vīro mahātejā hi tārakam |
jaghāna triśikhenāśu ghoreṇa niśitena tam ||
2.4.d:
वीरभद्रस्तथा वीरो महातेजा हि तारकम् ।
जघान त्रिशिखेनाशु घोरेण निशितेन तम् ॥
2.4.m: Likewise the hero Vīrabhadra, of great splendor, / swiftly struck Tāraka with a fierce, sharp three-pronged spear.

2.4.s:
so'pi śaktyā vīrabhadraṃ jaghāna samare tataḥ |
tārako ditijādhīśaḥ prabalo vīrasammataḥ ||
2.4.d:
सोऽपि शक्त्या वीरभद्रं जघान समरे ततः ।
तारको दितिजाधीशः प्रबलो वीरसम्मतः ॥
2.4.m: Then he too struck Vīrabhadra with a spear in the combat; / Tāraka was the lord of the sons of Diti, powerful and acclaimed as a hero.

2.4.s:
evaṃ saṃyuddhyamānau tau jaghnatuścetaretaram |
nānāstraśastraiḥ samare raṇavidyāviśāradau ||
2.4.d:
एवं संयुद्ध्यमानौ तौ जघ्नतुश्चेतरेतरम् ।
नानास्त्रशस्त्रैः समरे रणविद्याविशारदौ ॥
2.4.m: Fighting thus, the two, skilled in the science of warfare, / struck each other in the battle with various missiles and weapons.

2.4.s:
tayormahātmanostatra dvandvayuddhamabhūttadā |
sarveṣāṃ paśyatāmeva tumulaṃ romaharṣaṇam ||
2.4.d:
तयोर्महात्मनोस्तत्र द्वन्द्वयुद्धमभूत्तदा ।
सर्वेषां पश्यतामेव तुमुलं रोमहर्षणम् ॥
2.4.m: Then between those two great-souled warriors there took place a single combat / that was tumultuous and hair-raising, before the eyes of all.

2.4.s:
tato bherīmṛdaṅgāśca paṭahānakagomukhāḥ |
vinedurvihatā vīraiḥ śṛṇvatāṃ subhayānakāḥ ||
2.4.d:
ततो भेरीमृदङ्गाश्च पटहानकगोमुखाः ।
विनेदुर्विहता वीरैः शृण्वतां सुभयानकाः ॥
2.4.m: Then kettledrums, mṛdaṅgas, paṭahas, ānaka drums, and gomukha horns, / beaten by heroes, resounded, terrifying to those who heard.

2.4.s:
yuyudhātetisannaddhau prahārairjarjarīkṛtau |
anyo'nyamatisaṃrabdhau tau budhāṅgārakāviva ||
2.4.d:
युयुधातेतिसन्नद्धौ प्रहारैर्जर्जरीकृतौ ।
अन्योऽन्यमतिसंरब्धौ तौ बुधाङ्गारकाविव ॥
2.4.m: Fully armored, battered by blows, / the two fought, fiercely enraged at each other like Mercury and Mars.

2.4.s:
evaṃ dṛṣṭvā tadā yuddhaṃ vīrabhadrasya tena ca |
tatra gatvā vīrabhadramavocastvaṃ śivapriyaḥ ||
2.4.d:
एवं दृष्ट्वा तदा युद्धं वीरभद्रस्य तेन च ।
तत्र गत्वा वीरभद्रमवोचस्त्वं शिवप्रियः ॥
2.4.m: Having seen that battle of Vīrabhadra with him, / you, dear to Śiva, went there and spoke to Vīrabhadra.

2.4.s:
nārada uvāca
vīrabhadra mahāvīra gaṇānāmagraṇīrbhavān |
nivartasva raṇādasmādrocate na vadhastvayā ||
2.4.d:
नारद उवाच
वीरभद्र महावीर गणानामग्रणीर्भवान् ।
निवर्तस्व रणादस्माद्रोचते न वधस्त्वया ॥
2.4.m: Nārada said: / O Vīrabhadra, great hero, you are the leader of the attendants; / withdraw from this battle; his killing by you is not fitting.

2.4.s:
evaṃ niśamya tvadvākyaṃ vīrabhadro gaṇāgraṇīḥ |
avadatsa ruṣāviṣṭastvāṃ tadā tu kṛtāñjaliḥ ||
2.4.d:
एवं निशम्य त्वद्वाक्यं वीरभद्रो गणाग्रणीः ।
अवदत्स रुषाविष्टस्त्वां तदा तु कृताञ्जलिः ॥
2.4.m: Hearing this speech of yours, Vīrabhadra, the leader of the attendants, / filled with wrath, then spoke to you with folded hands.

2.4.s:
vīrabhadra uvāca
munivarya mahāprājña śṛṇu me paramaṃ vacaḥ |
tārakaṃ ca vadhiṣyāmi paśya me'dya parākramam ||
2.4.d:
वीरभद्र उवाच
मुनिवर्य महाप्राज्ञ शृणु मे परमं वचः ।
तारकं च वधिष्यामि पश्य मेऽद्य पराक्रमम् ॥
2.4.m: Vīrabhadra said: / O best of sages, O greatly wise one, hear my supreme words; / I will slay Tāraka; witness my prowess today.

2.4.s:
ānayanti ca ye vīrāḥsvāminaṃ raṇasaṃsadi |
te pāpino mahāklībā vinaśyanti raṇaṃ gatāḥ ||
2.4.d:
आनयन्ति च ये वीराःस्वामिनं रणसंसदि ।
ते पापिनो महाक्लीबा विनश्यन्ति रणं गताः ॥
2.4.m: The warriors who bring their master to the assembly of battle / are sinners and great cowards; having gone to battle, they perish.

2.4.s:
asadgatiṃ prāpnuvanti teṣāṃ ca nirayo dhruvam |
vīrabhadro hi vijñeyo na vācyaste kadācana ||
2.4.d:
असद्गतिं प्राप्नुवन्ति तेषां च निरयो ध्रुवम् ।
वीरभद्रो हि विज्ञेयो न वाच्यस्ते कदाचन ॥
2.4.m: They reach an evil destination, and hell is certain for them; / Vīrabhadra is indeed to be known thus; you should never say [this].

2.4.s:
śastrāstrairbhinnagātrā ye raṇaṃ kurvanti nirbhayāḥ |
ihāmutra praśaṃsyāste labhante sukhamadbhutam ||
2.4.d:
शस्त्रास्त्रैर्भिन्नगात्रा ये रणं कुर्वन्ति निर्भयाः ।
इहामुत्र प्रशंस्यास्ते लभन्ते सुखमद्भुतम् ॥
2.4.m: Those whose limbs are pierced by weapons and missiles, who fight fearlessly, / are praiseworthy here and in the hereafter; they attain wondrous happiness.

2.4.s:
śṛṇvantu mama vākyāni devā haripurogamāḥ |
atārakāṃ mahīmadya kariṣye svāmivarjitaḥ ||
2.4.d:
शृण्वन्तु मम वाक्यानि देवा हरिपुरोगमाः ।
अतारकां महीमद्य करिष्ये स्वामिवर्जितः ॥
2.4.m: Let the gods headed by Hari hear my words: / Today, without our lord, I shall rid the earth of Tāraka.

2.4.s:
ityuktvā pramarthaissārddhaṃ vīrabhadro hi śūladhṛk |
vicintya manasā śambhuṃ yuyudhe tārakeṇa hi ||
2.4.d:
इत्युक्त्वा प्रमर्थैस्सार्द्धं वीरभद्रो हि शूलधृक् ।
विचिन्त्य मनसा शम्भुं युयुधे तारकेण हि ॥
2.4.m: Having spoken thus, trident-bearing Vīrabhadra, along with the Pramathas, / contemplating Śambhu in his mind, fought indeed with Tāraka.

2.4.s:
vṛṣārūḍhairanekaiśca triśūlavaradhāribhiḥ |
mahāvīraiḥ trinetraiśca sa reje raṇasaṅgataḥ ||
2.4.d:
वृषारूढैरनेकैश्च त्रिशूलवरधारिभिः ।
महावीरैः त्रिनेत्रैश्च स रेजे रणसङ्गतः ॥
2.4.m: Accompanied by many mounted upon bulls, wielding excellent tridents, / mighty heroes possessing three eyes, he shone forth as he entered the battle.

2.4.s:
kolāhalaṃ prakurvanto nirbhayāḥ śataśo gaṇāḥ |
vīrabhadraṃ puraskṛtya yuyudhurdānavaiḥ saha ||
2.4.d:
कोलाहलं प्रकुर्वन्तो निर्भयाः शतशो गणाः ।
वीरभद्रं पुरस्कृत्य युयुधुर्दानवैः सह ॥
2.4.m: Making a loud clamor, fearless attendants by the hundreds, / placing Vīrabhadra at their head, fought against the Dānavas.

2.4.s:
asurāste'pi yuyudhuḥ tārakāsurajīvinaḥ |
balotkaṭā mahāvīrā mardayanto gaṇān ruṣā ||
2.4.d:
असुरास्तेऽपि युयुधुः तारकासुरजीविनः ।
बलोत्कटा महावीरा मर्दयन्तो गणान् रुषा ॥
2.4.m: Those asuras too, living under the demon Tāraka, / exceedingly mighty and great heroes, fought, crushing the attendants in anger.

2.4.s:
punaḥ punaścaiva babhūva saṅgaro mahotkaṭo daityavarairgaṇānām |
praharṣamāṇāḥ paramāstrakovidāḥ tadā gaṇāste jayino babhūvuḥ ||
2.4.d:
पुनः पुनश्चैव बभूव सङ्गरो महोत्कटो दैत्यवरैर्गणानाम् ।
प्रहर्षमाणाः परमास्त्रकोविदाः तदा गणास्ते जयिनो बभूवुः ॥
2.4.m: Again and again there was a fierce battle between the attendants and the foremost Daityas; / rejoicing, skilled in supreme weapons, the attendants then became victorious.

2.4.s:
gaṇairjitāste prabalairasurā vimukhā raṇe |
palāyanaparā jātā vyathitā vyagramānasāḥ ||
2.4.d:
गणैर्जितास्ते प्रबलैरसुरा विमुखा रणे ।
पलायनपरा जाता व्यथिता व्यग्रमानसाः ॥
2.4.m: Conquered by the powerful attendants, those asuras turned away from the battle; / they took to flight, tormented and agitated in mind.

2.4.s:
evaṃ bhraṣṭaṃ svasainyaṃ tad dṛṣṭvā tatpālako'suraḥ |
tārako hi ruṣāviṣṭo hantuṃ devagaṇān yayau ||
2.4.d:
एवं भ्रष्टं स्वसैन्यं तद् दृष्ट्वा तत्पालकोऽसुरः ।
तारको हि रुषाविष्टो हन्तुं देवगणान् ययौ ॥
2.4.m: Seeing his army thus broken, the demon, their protector, / Tāraka, overcome with wrath, went forth to slay the hosts of gods.

2.4.s:
bhujānāmayutaṃ kṛtvā siṃhamāruhya vegataḥ |
pātayāmāsa tāndevān gaṇāṃśca raṇamūrddhani ||
2.4.d:
भुजानामयुतं कृत्वा सिंहमारुह्य वेगतः ।
पातयामास तान्देवान् गणांश्च रणमूर्द्धनि ॥
2.4.m: Manifesting ten thousand arms and swiftly mounting a lion, / he struck down those gods and attendants at the front of battle.

2.4.s:
sa dṛṣṭvā tasya tatkarma vīrabhadro gaṇāgraṇīḥ |
cakāra sumahatkopaṃ tadvadhāya mahābalī ||
2.4.d:
स दृष्ट्वा तस्य तत्कर्म वीरभद्रो गणाग्रणीः ।
चकार सुमहत्कोपं तद्वधाय महाबली ॥
2.4.m: Seeing that deed of his, Vīrabhadra, the leader of the attendants, / very powerful, felt great anger in order to slay him.

2.4.s:
smṛtvā śivapadāmbhojaṃ jagrāha triśikhaṃ param |
jajvalustejasā tasya diśaḥ sarvā nabhastathā ||
2.4.d:
स्मृत्वा शिवपदाम्भोजं जग्राह त्रिशिखं परम् ।
जज्वलुस्तेजसा तस्य दिशः सर्वा नभस्तथा ॥
2.4.m: Remembering the lotus feet of Śiva, he seized a supreme three-pronged spear; / by its brilliance, all the quarters and the sky blazed forth.

2.4.s:
etasminnantare svāmī vārayāmāsa taṃ raṇāt |
vīrabāhumukhānsadyo mahākautukadarśakaḥ ||
2.4.d:
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे स्वामी वारयामास तं रणात् ।
वीरबाहुमुखान्सद्यो महाकौतुकदर्शकः ॥
2.4.m: Meanwhile the Master, wishing to see a great spectacle, / immediately held him back from the battle, along with Vīrabāhu and the others.

2.4.s:
tadājñayā vīrabhadro nivṛtto'bhūdraṇāttadā |
kopaṃ cakre mahāvīrastārako'suranāyakaḥ ||
2.4.d:
तदाज्ञया वीरभद्रो निवृत्तोऽभूद्रणात्तदा ।
कोपं चक्रे महावीरस्तारकोऽसुरनायकः ॥
2.4.m: By his command, Vīrabhadra then turned back from the battle; / the great hero Tāraka, the leader of the asuras, became enraged.

2.4.s:
cakāra bāṇavṛṣṭiṃ ca suropari tadā'suraḥ |
tapto''hvāsītsurānsadyo nānāstraraṇakovidaḥ ||
2.4.d:
चकार बाणवृष्टिं च सुरोपरि तदाऽसुरः ।
तप्तो'ऽह्वासीत्सुरान्सद्यो नानास्त्ररणकोविदः ॥
2.4.m: Then the asura made a shower of arrows upon the gods; / skilled in combat with various weapons, the burning [demon] swiftly challenged the gods.

2.4.s:
evaṃ kṛtvā mahatkarma tārako'surapālakaḥ |
sarveṣāmapi devānāmaśakyo balināṃ varaḥ ||
2.4.d:
एवं कृत्वा महत्कर्म तारकोऽसुरपालकः ।
सर्वेषामपि देवानामशक्यो बलिनां वरः ॥
2.4.m: Having accomplished such a great deed, Tāraka, the protector of the asuras, / the foremost of the strong, could not be overcome even by all the gods.

2.4.s:
evaṃ nihanyamānāṃstān dṛṣṭvā devān bhayākulān |
kopaṃ kṛtvā raṇāyāśu sannaddho'bhavadacyutaḥ ||
2.4.d:
एवं निहन्यमानांस्तान् दृष्ट्वा देवान् भयाकुलान् ।
कोपं कृत्वा रणायाशु सन्नद्धोऽभवदच्युतः ॥
2.4.m: Seeing those gods being struck down and overcome with fear, / Acyuta grew angry and quickly prepared for battle.

2.4.s:
cakraṃ sudarśanaṃ śārṅgaṃ dhanurādāya sāyudhaḥ |
abhyudyayau mahādaityaṃ raṇāya bhagavān hariḥ ||
2.4.d:
चक्रं सुदर्शनं शार्ङ्गं धनुरादाय सायुधः ।
अभ्युद्ययौ महादैत्यं रणाय भगवान् हरिः ॥
2.4.m: Taking the Sudarśana discus and the Śārṅga bow, equipped with weapons, / the lord Hari advanced against the great Daitya for battle.

2.4.s:
tataḥsamabhavadyuddhaṃ haritārakayormahat |
lomaharṣaṇamatyugraṃ sarveṣāṃ paśyatāṃ mune ||
2.4.d:
ततःसमभवद्युद्धं हरितारकयोर्महत् ।
लोमहर्षणमत्युग्रं सर्वेषां पश्यतां मुने ॥
2.4.m: Then a great battle took place between Hari and Tāraka, / hair-raising and exceedingly fierce, while all looked on, O sage.

2.4.s:
gadāmudyamya sa harirjaghānāsuramojasā |
dvidhā cakāra tāṃ daityastriśikhena mahābalī ||
2.4.d:
गदामुद्यम्य स हरिर्जघानासुरमोजसा ।
द्विधा चकार तां दैत्यस्त्रिशिखेन महाबली ॥
2.4.m: Raising his mace, Hari struck the asura with might; / the very powerful Daitya split it in two with his trident.

2.4.s:
tataḥ sa kruddho bhagavāndevānāmabhayaṅkaraḥ |
śārṅgacyutaiḥ śaravyūhairjaghānāsuranāyakam ||
so'pi daityo mahāvīrastārakaḥ paravīrahā |
ciccheda sakalānbāṇānsvaśarairniśitairdrutam ||
2.4.d:
ततः स क्रुद्धो भगवान्देवानामभयङ्करः ।
शार्ङ्गच्युतैः शरव्यूहैर्जघानासुरनायकम् ॥
सोऽपि दैत्यो महावीरस्तारकः परवीरहा ।
चिच्छेद सकलान्बाणान्स्वशरैर्निशितैर्द्रुतम् ॥
2.4.m:
Then the enraged Lord, who grants fearlessness to the gods, / struck the leader of the asuras with volleys of arrows shot from the Śārṅga bow.

That Daitya too, the mighty hero Tāraka, slayer of enemy warriors, / quickly severed all the arrows with his own sharpened arrows.

2.4.s:
atha śaktyā jaghānāśu murāriṃ tārakāsuraḥ |
bhūmau papāta sa haristatprahāreṇa mūrcchitaḥ ||
2.4.d:
अथ शक्त्या जघानाशु मुरारिं तारकासुरः ।
भूमौ पपात स हरिस्तत्प्रहारेण मूर्च्छितः ॥
2.4.m: Then the demon Tāraka swiftly struck Murāri with a spear; / Hari fell to the ground, fainting from that blow.

2.4.s:
jagrāha sa ruṣā cakramutthitaḥ kṣaṇato'cyutaḥ |
siṃhanādaṃ mahatkṛtvā jvalajjvālāsamākulam ||
2.4.d:
जग्राह स रुषा चक्रमुत्थितः क्षणतोऽच्युतः ।
सिंहनादं महत्कृत्वा ज्वलज्ज्वालासमाकुलम् ॥
2.4.m: Rising up in a moment, Acyuta angrily seized his discus, / and letting out a great lion's roar, [hurled that discus] filled with blazing flames.

2.4.s:
tena taṃ ca jaghānāsau daityānāmadhipaṃ hariḥ |
tatprahāreṇa mahatā vyathito nyapatadbhuvi ||
2.4.d:
तेन तं च जघानासौ दैत्यानामधिपं हरिः ।
तत्प्रहारेण महता व्यथितो न्यपतद्भुवि ॥
2.4.m: With it, Hari struck that ruler of the Daityas; / tormented by that great blow, he fell to the earth.

2.4.s:
punaścotthāya daityendrastārako'suranāyakaḥ |
ciccheda tvaritaṃ cakraṃ svaśaktyātibalānvitaḥ ||
2.4.d:
पुनश्चोत्थाय दैत्येन्द्रस्तारकोऽसुरनायकः ।
चिच्छेद त्वरितं चक्रं स्वशक्त्यातिबलान्वितः ॥
2.4.m: Rising up once again, the lord of Daityas, Tāraka, the leader of the asuras, / endowed with extreme strength, quickly cut through the discus with his spear.

2.4.s:
punastayā mahāśaktyā jaghānāmaravallabham |
acyuto'pi mahāvīro nandakena jaghāna tam ||
2.4.d:
पुनस्तया महाशक्त्या जघानामरवल्लभम् ।
अच्युतोऽपि महावीरो नन्दकेन जघान तम् ॥
2.4.m: Again with that great spear, he struck the beloved of the gods; / Acyuta too, a mighty hero, struck him with the Nandaka [sword].

2.4.s:
evamanyo'nyamasuro viṣṇuśca balavānubhau |
yuyudhāte raṇe bhūri tatrākṣatabalau mune ||
śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ ||
śrīgaurīśaṅkarābhyāṃ namaḥ ||
śrīśivamahāpurāṇam ||
dvitīyāyāṃ rudrasaṃhitāyāṃ caturthaḥ kumārakhaṇḍe
2.4.d:
एवमन्योऽन्यमसुरो विष्णुश्च बलवानुभौ ।
युयुधाते रणे भूरि तत्राक्षतबलौ मुने ॥
श्रीगणेशाय नमः ॥
श्रीगौरीशङ्कराभ्यां नमः ॥
श्रीशिवमहापुराणम् ॥
द्वितीयायां रुद्रसंहितायां चतुर्थः कुमारखण्डे
2.4.m:
Thus the asura and powerful Viṣṇu, both / of unyielding strength, fought fiercely against one another in battle, O sage.

Thus ends the eighth chapter, named 'Description of the General Battle Between the Gods and Daityas', in the Kumārakhaṇḍa, the fourth section of the second saṃhitā, the Rudrasaṃhitā, in the glorious Śiva Mahāpurāṇa.

2.4.s:
brahmovāca devadeva guha svāmin śāṅkare pārvatīsuta |
na śobhate raṇo viṣṇutārakāsurayorvṛthā ||
2.4.d:
ब्रह्मोवाच देवदेव गुह स्वामिन् शाङ्करे पार्वतीसुत ।
न शोभते रणो विष्णुतारकासुरयोर्वृथा ॥
2.4.m: Brahmā said: / O god of gods, Guha, Master, son of Śaṅkara, son of Pārvatī! / The vain battle between Viṣṇu and the demon Tāraka is not fitting.

2.4.s:
viṣṇunā na hi vadhyo'sau tārako balavānati |
mayā dattavarastasmātsatyaṃ satyaṃ vadāmyaham ||
2.4.d:
विष्णुना न हि वध्योऽसौ तारको बलवानति ।
मया दत्तवरस्तस्मात्सत्यं सत्यं वदाम्यहम् ॥
2.4.m: This exceedingly powerful Tāraka cannot be slain by Viṣṇu, / for a boon was granted by me to him; I speak the truth, the truth.

2.4.s:
nānyo hantāsya pāpasya tvāṃ vinā pārvatīsuta |
tasmāttvayā hi kartavyaṃ vacanaṃ me mahāprabho ||
2.4.d:
नान्यो हन्तास्य पापस्य त्वां विना पार्वतीसुत ।
तस्मात्त्वया हि कर्तव्यं वचनं मे महाप्रभो ॥
2.4.m: There is no other slayer of this sinner except you, O son of Pārvatī; / therefore you must heed my word, O great lord.

2.4.s:
sannaddho bhava daityasya vadhāyāśu parantapa |
tadvadhārthaṃ samutpannaḥ śaṅkarāttvaṃ śivāsuta ||
2.4.d:
सन्नद्धो भव दैत्यस्य वधायाशु परन्तप ।
तद्वधार्थं समुत्पन्नः शङ्करात्त्वं शिवासुत ॥
2.4.m: Equip yourself quickly for the slaying of the Daitya, O scorcher of foes; / you were born from Śaṅkara for the sake of his destruction, O son of Śivā!

2.4.s:
rakṣa rakṣa mahāvīra tridaśān vyathitān raṇe |
na bālastvaṃ yuvā naiva kiṃ tu sarveśvaraḥ prabhuḥ ||
2.4.d:
रक्ष रक्ष महावीर त्रिदशान् व्यथितान् रणे ।
न बालस्त्वं युवा नैव किं तु सर्वेश्वरः प्रभुः ॥
2.4.m: Protect, protect the gods tormented in battle, O mighty hero! / You are neither a boy nor a youth, but the Lord and Master of all.

2.4.s:
śakraṃ paśya tathā viṣṇuṃ vyākulaṃ ca surān gaṇān |
enaṃ jahi mahādaityaṃ trailokyaṃ sukhitaṃ kuru ||
2.4.d:
शक्रं पश्य तथा विष्णुं व्याकुलं च सुरान् गणान् ।
एनं जहि महादैत्यं त्रैलोक्यं सुखितं कुरु ॥
2.4.m: Look at Śakra and Viṣṇu, agitated, and at the gods and the attendants; / slay this great Daitya, make the three worlds happy!

2.4.s:
anena vijitaścendro lokapālaiḥ purā saha |
viṣṇuścāpi mahāvīro tarjitastapaso balāt ||
2.4.d:
अनेन विजितश्चेन्द्रो लोकपालैः पुरा सह ।
विष्णुश्चापि महावीरो तर्जितस्तपसो बलात् ॥
2.4.m: Formerly Indra along with the guardians of the world was conquered by him, / and mighty Viṣṇu as well was threatened by the power of his austerity.

2.4.s:
trailokyaṃ nirjitaṃ sarvamasureṇa durātmanā |
idānīṃ tava sānnidhyātpunaryuddhaṃ kṛtaṃ ca taiḥ ||
2.4.d:
त्रैलोक्यं निर्जितं सर्वमसुरेण दुरात्मना ।
इदानीं तव सान्निध्यात्पुनर्युद्धं कृतं च तैः ॥
2.4.m: All the three worlds were completely conquered by the evil-minded asura; / now, due to your presence, battle has been waged by them again.

2.4.s:
tasmāttvayā nihantavyastārakaḥ pāpapūruṣaḥ |
anyavadhyo na caivāyaṃ madvarācchaṅkarātmaja ||
2.4.d:
तस्मात्त्वया निहन्तव्यस्तारकः पापपूरुषः ।
अन्यवध्यो न चैवायं मद्वराच्छङ्करात्मज ॥
2.4.m: Therefore the sinful person Tāraka must be slain by you; / by my boon he cannot be killed by any other, O son of Śaṅkara.

2.4.s:
iti śrutvā mama vacaḥ kumāraḥ śaṅkarātmajaḥ |
vijahāsa prasannātmā tathāstviti vaco'bravīt ||
2.4.d:
इति श्रुत्वा मम वचः कुमारः शङ्करात्मजः ।
विजहास प्रसन्नात्मा तथास्त्विति वचोऽब्रवीत् ॥
2.4.m: Hearing these words of mine, Kumāra, the son of Śaṅkara, / laughed with a pleased mind and said the words: 'So be it.'

2.4.s:
viniścityāsuravadhaṃ śāṅkariḥsa mahāprabhuḥ |
vimānādavatīryātha padātirabhavattadā ||
2.4.d:
विनिश्चित्यासुरवधं शाङ्करिःस महाप्रभुः ।
विमानादवतीर्याथ पदातिरभवत्तदा ॥
2.4.m: Having resolved upon the destruction of the asura, the son of Śaṅkara, that great lord, / descended from his chariot and became a foot soldier then.

2.4.s:
padbhyāṃ tadāsau paridhāvamāno reje'tivīraḥ śivajaḥ kumāraḥ |
kare samādāya mahāprabhāṃ tāṃ śaktiṃ maholkāmiva dīptidīptām ||
2.4.d:
पद्भ्यां तदासौ परिधावमानो रेजेऽतिवीरः शिवजः कुमारः ।
करे समादाय महाप्रभां तां शक्तिं महोल्कामिव दीप्तिदीप्ताम् ॥
